desc.zh: 输入一个主题即可生成押韵英文诗歌的免费在线工具，无需注册打开即用，界面极简，适合贺卡、社交配文与英语课堂等轻量创作场景。
desc.en: Free browser tool that turns a topic into rhyming English verse. No signup — handy for cards, captions and classroom exercises.

desc.zh: 一站式中文 AI 写作工具，官方称覆盖论文、公文、PPT、简历等 200 多个真实场景，提供大纲生成、文档续写润色、降重与去 AI 痕迹、简历与新媒体文案等能力。
desc.en: Chinese AI writing suite covering 200+ scenarios from theses and official documents to slides and resumes, with outlining, rewriting, deduplication and AI-trace removal.

desc.zh: 面向企业的 AI 平台与模型服务商，提供可私有化部署的智能体平台 North 与自研模型，帮企业把内部分散数据转成可用洞察与自动化流程。
desc.en: Enterprise AI platform and model provider, offering the deployable North agent platform alongside in-house models that turn scattered internal data into insight and automation.

desc.zh: 浏览器写作扩展，在你打字的地方自动补全句子并按你的语气给出个性化建议，官方称可省约 40% 写作时间，已有 1 万+ 团队与 40 万人使用，可免费安装。
desc.en: Browser extension that autocompletes sentences and suggests phrasing in your own tone wherever you type. Free to install.

desc.zh: 基于 ChatGPT 的写作编辑工具，官方定位是「用强大的 AI 编辑器校对、编辑并改进你的写作」，并且特别强调「在 Word 中追踪修改」这一能力——每条修改都能像人工编辑一样被查看、接受或拒绝。
desc.en: ChatGPT-powered writing editor that improves text inside Word using tracked changes you can review, accept or reject one at a time.

desc.zh: 老牌 AI 写作助手，在任意网站和应用中提供语法校对、段落重写、语气调整、去 AI 味与 AI 检测等能力，官网定位为随时可用的 AI 写作伙伴，覆盖职场与教育两类场景。
desc.en: Long-established AI writing assistant handling grammar, rewriting, tone adjustment and AI detection across any website or app.

desc.zh: Groq 自研 LPU 芯片驱动的推理云，以超低延迟运行 Llama、Mixtral 等开源模型，OpenAI 兼容 API 迁移成本低，官方称每周处理数万亿 token。
desc.en: Inference cloud running open models like Llama and Mixtral on Groq's own LPU chips, with an OpenAI-compatible API for easy migration.

desc.zh: AI 写作助手，提供预测式自动补全、联网搜索与引用、AutoWrite 生成等数百个写作与研究工具，可在 AI 文档编辑器内一站式完成从起草到润色的全流程。
desc.en: AI writing assistant with predictive autocomplete, web-grounded search and citations, AutoWrite generation, and hundreds of writing and research tools.

desc.zh: 科大讯飞旗下AI写作生成器，支持对话式写作与改写、扩写、缩写，可按场景模板快速成文，并能上传音视频与Office文档，一键摘要总结、生成思维导图。
desc.en: iFlytek's AI writing generator with conversational drafting, rewrite/expand/shorten, scene templates, and summarisation or mind maps from uploaded audio, video and Office files.

desc.zh: 面向学生与研究者的学术写作助手，从自己导入的文献库写作、边写边引并自动生成引用，支持跨库提问、2 亿+ 篇论文检索与投稿前检查。
desc.en: Academic writing assistant for students and researchers: draft from your own PDF library, cite as you type, query across sources and run pre-submission checks.

desc.zh: Jetwriter 是一款个人 AI 写作助手，官方宣传语是「你的个人 AI 写作助手，在任何网站上都能用」（Use AI on Any Site）。
desc.en: Personal AI writing assistant that works on any site — draft emails, fix grammar, translate, summarise, explain and rewrite without switching tabs.

desc.zh: Lex 是一款内置 AI 的现代写作工具，官方定位是「协作文档 + 强大的 AI 编辑工具」，被不少用户当作 Google Docs 的替代品。
desc.en: Modern writing tool with AI built in, positioned as collaborative docs plus a powerful AI editor, and widely used as a Google Docs alternative.

desc.zh: 面向毕业论文的 AI 写作与查重助手，官方称依托超两亿篇中文文献提供文献搜集、提纲生成与全文灵感，覆盖查重降重、AIGC 检测、答辩 PPT 与就业辅助。
desc.en: AI writing and plagiarism-check assistant for graduation theses, drawing on 200M+ Chinese papers for literature search, outlining and full-text drafting, plus AIGC detection.

desc.zh: MiniMax 是一家多模态大模型公司，官方使命是「让智能属于每个人」，自称全球多模态模型与 AI 原生产品的领先者，拥有超过 2 亿用户。
desc.en: Multimodal model company behind the MiniMax and Hailuo product lines, with 200M+ users, open-weight models and a public API.

desc.zh: 秘塔出品的中英文 AI 写作辅助平台，主打「言出法随」语音成稿，集智能纠错、改写润色、自动续写与智能配图于一体，支持从空文本起草或上传 Word 继续写作。
desc.en: Mita's bilingual AI writing platform, combining error correction, rewriting, auto-continuation and auto-illustration with voice-to-draft dictation.

desc.zh: 长文写作 AI 助手，提供博客、技术指南、教案、Newsletter 等长内容模板，一句话提示即可起稿，官方口号是「不再从空白页开始」，面向英文写作场景。
desc.en: Long-form AI writing assistant with templates for blogs, technical guides, lesson plans and newsletters — starting from a prompt instead of a blank page.

desc.zh: Notion 内置的 AI 工作空间能力，可捕获知识、跨应用检索并生成带引用的答案，还支持用自定义 Agent 自动处理重复工作。
desc.en: AI layer inside Notion that captures knowledge, searches across your connected apps and answers with citations, plus custom agents for repetitive work.

desc.zh: 面向科研与学术场景的 AI 写作助手，提供语法校对、改写、查重与引用检查，改写建议基于 2.5 亿篇以上研究论文，覆盖从文献到投稿前检查的完整科研写作流程。
desc.en: AI writing assistant for research, with grammar checks, rewriting, plagiarism and citation checks grounded in a corpus of 250M+ papers.

desc.zh: AI 写作辅助工具，主打校对、改写与扩展三大能力，可查错别字与事实性错误、做同义改写降重与书面语转换，并支持多端同步与历史版本恢复。
desc.en: AI writing assistant built around proofreading, rewriting and expansion — catches typos and factual errors, rewrites for originality and converts text to formal register.

desc.zh: QuillBot 的官方定位已经从「改写工具」扩展为完整的 AI 写作套件，口号是「你唯一需要的 AI 订阅」。
desc.en: A paraphraser grown into a full AI writing suite: grammar checking, plagiarism checking, AI detection, translation, summarisation and citation generation.

desc.zh: Rytr 是一款 AI 写作助手，官方 slogan 是「AI 生成原创且有说服力的内容，听起来像你而不是机器人」。
desc.en: AI writing assistant that generates original, persuasive copy in a voice that sounds like you rather than a bot.

desc.zh: 深言科技推出的找词找句工具，孵化自清华大学自然语言处理实验室，支持据意查词、据意查句、词汇检索与汉英双语查询，帮写作者找到更恰切的表达。
desc.en: Word and sentence finder from Shenyan Tech, incubated at Tsinghua's NLP lab — search by meaning in Chinese or English to land on the right phrasing.

desc.zh: 专为虚构写作打造的 AI 写作工具，自研 Muse 模型面向小说场景优化，提供故事续写、感官细节描写、脑暴与改写等能力，被多位畅销书作者与编剧用于长篇小说创作。
desc.en: AI writing tool built specifically for fiction, with a Muse model tuned for novels and features for story continuation, sensory detail, brainstorming and rewriting.

desc.zh: 企业级 AI 智能体基础设施，帮企业在自有数据上安全部署与治理 AI 智能体，官网展示的客户成效包括 240 万次使用、55 万美元节省与 75% 效率提升等指标。
desc.en: Enterprise AI agent infrastructure for deploying and governing agents safely on your own data.

desc.zh: Together AI 是 AI 原生云平台，提供开源模型推理、微调与 GPU 集群，OpenAI 兼容接口迁移方便，官方称推理快 2 倍、成本低 60%、预训练快 90%。
desc.en: AI-native cloud offering open-model inference, fine-tuning and GPU clusters, with an OpenAI-compatible API for easy migration.

desc.zh: 美团旗下小说创作与投稿平台，一句话即可生成小说，官方称内置 5000 多个创作工作流，覆盖长短篇正文、剧本转换、漫剧视频与一键投稿审核。
desc.en: Meituan's novel-writing and submission platform — generates fiction from a single prompt, with thousands of built-in workflows covering short and long form, scripts and comic video.

desc.zh: 英文写作润色助手，按语境给出贴合个人风格的改写建议，一键切换正式或随意语气，支持拼写语法校对与续写，可免费使用、无需信用卡。
desc.en: English writing assistant that suggests context-aware rewrites in your own style and flips between formal and casual tone in one click. Free, no credit card.

desc.zh: 现已转型为 AI 搜索增长引擎，面向 GEO 与 AEO 场景：追踪品牌在多个 AI 平台的可见度，并产出内容与引用优化动作，官网称服务亚马逊、联合利华等上万家企业市场团队。
desc.en: Now an AI search growth engine for GEO and AEO: it tracks brand visibility across AI platforms and produces the content and citation improvements to match.

desc.zh: 新华社国家重点实验室与博特智能合作的 AI 写作平台，聚焦公文写作、文稿审校与国标格式排版，内置政企知识库，并提供个人版、团队版与私有化部署形态。
desc.en: AI writing platform from Xinhua's State Key Laboratory and Bot Smart, focused on official document drafting, proofreading and national-standard formatting with a built-in knowledge base.

desc.zh: 科大讯飞推出的文档生成工具，输入一句话主题或长文本即可生成 Word 与 PPT，支持多语种文本互译、AI 自动配图与模板配色切换，并能基于 PPT 内容自动生成演讲稿。
desc.en: iFlytek's document generator that turns a one-line topic or long text into Word and PPT, with translation, auto-illustration and auto-generated speaker notes.

desc.zh: 360推出的AI图片创作平台，提供智能生成背景、一键成图与模板化图文素材，并配套高清版权图库，面向新媒体配图、营销物料与日常设计等场景。
desc.en: 360's AI image creation platform with background generation, one-click image making and templated graphics, backed by a licensed high-resolution stock library.

desc.zh: 万兴科技推出的AI绘画平台，支持文字生成图片与图片生成图片，内置多种风格模型并支持中英文双语创作，官方说明生成内容的权利归属用户，面向创意设计与内容配图。
desc.en: Wondershare's AI art platform for text-to-image and image-to-image, with multiple style models, bilingual prompts and full rights to generated content.

desc.zh: 全球最大的生成式 AI 模型社区，可发现、下载与在线运行 Stable Diffusion、Flux 等开源模型，也支持图像、视频、3D 内容的创作与分享。
desc.en: The largest generative AI model community — discover, download and run open models like Stable Diffusion and Flux, and share image, video and 3D creations.

desc.zh: 免费文生图工具（前身 DALL·E mini），输入文字即可生成艺术、照片、插画等图片，并提供 Logo、动漫、纹身、室内设计等垂直生成入口与图片搜索。
desc.en: Free text-to-image tool (formerly DALL·E mini) that generates art, photos and illustrations from a prompt, with vertical generators for logos, anime and interiors.

desc.zh: 老牌 AI 工具站，提供图像生成、视频、音乐、语音聊天与照片编辑等能力，并配套移动端与 Chrome 插件，官网主打「给有创造力的人用的 AI 工具」。
desc.en: Veteran AI toolset covering image generation, video, music, voice chat and photo editing, with mobile and Chrome apps.

desc.zh: 阿里旗下全能 AI 设计 Agent，官网介绍其提供 Qwen、通义万相 Wan 系列等模型的官方体验入口，支持图片视频生成、3D 素材在线渲染与免费商用素材。
desc.en: Alibaba's all-in-one AI design agent, offering official access to Qwen and Tongyi Wanxiang models, image and video generation, online 3D rendering and free commercial assets.

desc.zh: 集成主流模型的 AI 创作工作台，可在一个空间里生成与编辑图像、视频、音乐与语音，官网主打无需研究模型与复杂配置即可开工，并提供 API。
desc.en: AI creation workspace aggregating mainstream models — generate and edit images, video, music and speech in one place, with a public API.

desc.zh: fal.ai 推出的生成图像模型竞技场，用同一提示词对比不同模型出图，按用户投票给出人气排名并标注样本量，覆盖商业与社区模型，可直接在线试玩。
desc.en: fal.ai's generative image model arena: run the same prompt across models, see community-voted rankings with sample sizes, and try them online.

desc.zh: 快手推出的可图大模型，提供中文文生图与AI形象定制能力，内置多种风格化模板与作品广场，支持一键同款，面向社交头像、创意配图与个人形象创作场景。
desc.en: Kuaishou's Kolors image model, offering Chinese text-to-image and AI avatar customisation with style templates and one-tap remixing.

desc.zh: 面向创作者与营销团队的生成式 AI 平台，可用提示词或自有模型生成高质量视觉，并支持图像编辑与视频化，官网主打帮市场与设计团队规模化产出内容。
desc.en: Generative AI platform for creators and marketing teams — produce high-quality visuals from prompts or custom models, then edit and animate them.

desc.zh: 国内主流 AI 创作平台，官网称提供 10 万+ 模型免费下载、在线 WebUI 与 ComfyUI 生图以及 LoRA 训练，图片与视频模型齐全，是国内创作者的主要据点之一。
desc.en: Major Chinese AI creation platform with 100k+ free model downloads, online WebUI and ComfyUI generation, and LoRA training across image and video models.

desc.zh: 原 Freepik 升级而来的 AI 创意平台，官网称汇聚图像、视频与音频的各类主流模型，覆盖从广告大片、产品图到影视制作的全流程创作，同时保留素材库能力。
desc.en: AI creative platform at Freepik, bringing together leading image, video and audio models for work ranging from ad visuals and product shots to film production.

desc.zh: 以画面美感著称的 AI 绘图服务，由社区资助的独立研究实验室打造，风格化能力强，支持参考图与角色一致性控制，付费订阅制。
desc.en: AI image service known for its aesthetic quality, built by an independent research lab funded by its community. Subscription-based, with reference images and character consistency.

desc.zh: 面向 AI 艺术爱好者的创作平台与社区，聚合多家主流生图模型，提供每日挑战、Promptle 等玩法，官网主打「为创意与乐趣而生」。
desc.en: Creation platform and community for AI art lovers, aggregating several major image models with daily challenges and Promptle.

desc.zh: 一站式 AI 创作平台，官网称汇聚 Google、OpenAI、Seedance 等 100+ 模型，支持图像、视频与音乐生成，已有 800 万+ 创作者使用。
desc.en: All-in-one AI creation platform spanning 100+ models from Google, OpenAI and others for image, video and music generation, used by 8M+ creators.

desc.zh: 面向增长与广告场景的视觉内容平台，提供 AI 图像编辑、生成与增强，官网主打「产出、测试并规模化那些能转化的创意素材」，覆盖广告、视频与商品图。
desc.en: Visual content platform for growth and advertising — AI image editing, generation and enhancement aimed at producing and scaling creatives that convert.

desc.zh: 国产免费在线 AI 修图工具集，提供画质增强、去背景、模糊变清晰等能力，覆盖商品图与日常照片处理，并提供面向开发者的 API。
desc.en: Free online AI photo toolkit with quality enhancement, background removal and unblurring, covering product and everyday photos, plus a developer API.

desc.zh: 专注二次元的 AI 绘画平台，官网称提供 180 万+ 动漫模型与 LoRA，输入提示词数秒出图并提供每日免费额度，另有 Studio、Recipe、创作比赛与移动端。
desc.en: Anime-focused AI art platform with 1.8M+ anime models and LoRAs, daily free credits, a studio, recipes and creation contests.

desc.zh: 面向所有人的 AI 设计工作室，官网主打把想法变成贴纸、周边、海报与各类图形，无需设计经验，提供模板起点与移动端 App。
desc.en: AI design studio that turns ideas into stickers, merchandise, posters and graphics without design experience, with template starting points and a mobile app.

desc.zh: 面向设计师与团队的 AI 图像平台，官网称其文生图模型在写实、矢量生成、自定义风格与样机方面表现突出，V4 Styles 可让整套图保持同一视觉风格。
desc.en: AI image platform for designers, strong in photorealism, vector generation, custom styles and mockups, with V4 Styles keeping a whole set visually consistent.

desc.zh: 一站式 AI 创作平台与社区，支持图像、视频、音频生成与智能聊天，首页可见 GPT Image 2.5、Seedance 2.5 等模型入口，可快速把创意变成作品并分享社区。
desc.en: All-in-one AI creation platform and community for image, video and audio generation plus chat, hosting models such as GPT Image and Seedance.

desc.zh: 商汤科技推出的AI作画平台，支持中文提示词文生图与图生图，提供多种风格模型，并支持LoRA训练定制形象与画风，官方称可免费使用，面向插画与IP创作场景。
desc.en: SenseTime's AI drawing platform with Chinese-prompt text-to-image and image-to-image, multiple style models and LoRA training for custom characters and looks. Free to use.

desc.zh: Stability AI 的生成式 AI 产品线，含开源图像模型与企业级图像、视频、3D/4D 模型与音频工具包，支持商用授权，可本地部署或走企业托管。
desc.en: Stability AI's generative line, from the open-source image model to enterprise image, video, 3D/4D and audio toolkits — licensable for commercial use and deployable locally.

desc.zh: 主打「上传一张图，AI 把它变成你想象的样子」的 AI 生图工具，支持文字与图片生成图像与视频，官网强调社区驱动与移动端随时创作。
desc.en: AI image tool built around turning an uploaded image into what you imagine, with text and image prompts for both images and video, plus mobile creation.

desc.zh: 免费的在线生图与模型托管平台，可在线运行模型生成图片与视频、训练模型，并提供素材库、工作流与角色创作等分区，适合不想本地部署的玩家。
desc.en: Free online image generation and model hosting — run hosted models to produce images and video, train your own, and browse assets, workflows and characters without local setup.

desc.zh: 阿里巴巴通义旗下的 AI 创意创作平台，官方称提供文生图、图生图、文生视频、图生视频与图像编辑能力，万相 3.0 支持原生 30 秒时长与多素材参考生成，面向生产力场景。
desc.en: Alibaba's Tongyi creative platform for text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video and image editing. Wanxiang 3.0 handles native 30-second clips and multi-reference generation.

desc.zh: 在线生图的AI模型分享社区，汇集Checkpoint与LoRA等模型并支持一键运行，覆盖二次元、摄影、电商、插画等风格，同时收录视频生成模型，供创作者共用与协作。
desc.en: Online image generation community sharing checkpoints and LoRAs with one-click running, spanning anime, photography, e-commerce and illustration, plus video models.

desc.zh: 美图公司推出的AI视觉创作平台，支持文生图、图生图以及改图、扩图、消除、高清修复等能力，还可将图片转为视频，面向个人创作者与商业设计场景。
desc.en: Meitu's AI visual creation platform with text-to-image, image-to-image, editing, outpainting, object removal and upscaling, plus image-to-video.

desc.zh: 剪映国际版 CapCut，覆盖移动端、桌面端与网页端的视频编辑平台，提供 AI 字幕、文生视频、智能模板与特效工具，配套海量创作模板，是全球头部短视频剪辑工具。
desc.en: ByteDance's video editor for mobile, desktop and web, with auto captions, text-to-video, smart templates and effects — one of the most widely used short-video editors.

desc.zh: 数字人平台 D-ID 提供视频生成与交互式 AI 虚拟人能力，最新推出 V4 表现型视觉智能体，支持实时、有情感反馈的对话体验，官网定位为领先的企业级数字人平台。
desc.en: Digital human platform offering video generation and interactive AI avatars, with V4 expressive visual agents for real-time, emotionally responsive conversation.

desc.zh: 文本驱动的 AI 视频与音频编辑器：把视频转成文字稿，像改文档一样删除语句即完成剪辑，配合 AI 协作编辑器 Underlord，让播客与口播视频的剪辑效率大幅提升。
desc.en: Text-driven video and audio editor: transcribe your footage and cut it by editing the transcript, with the Underlord AI co-editor speeding up podcasts and talking-head video.

desc.zh: 文字转视频工具，内置 2000+ AI 音色、覆盖 80+ 语言，把文本、脚本或博客文章快速转成带配音与画面的视频，官网强调无需出镜与剪辑技能，提供永久免费计划。
desc.en: Text-to-video tool with 2000+ AI voices across 80+ languages, turning scripts, articles or blog posts into narrated videos — no camera or editing skills required.

desc.zh: 一站式 AI 视频生成与增强平台，支持文生视频、图生视频、视频转动画风格、一致角色与口型同步等能力，官网标注已有超过 300 万创作者使用。
desc.en: All-in-one AI video generation and enhancement platform supporting text-to-video, image-to-video, style transfer to animation, consistent characters and lip sync.

desc.zh: MiniMax 旗下 AI 助手与视频生成平台，依托自研视频模型提供文生视频与图生视频能力，动作流畅度与主体一致性表现突出，同时集成了智能问答与语音等通用 AI 功能。
desc.en: MiniMax's assistant and video generation platform, with in-house models known for smooth motion and subject consistency, alongside general chat and voice features.

desc.zh: AI 数字人视频平台，几分钟生成以你为主角的真人级口播视频，主打 Avatar V 角色一致性，支持多角度拍摄、精准口型同步、情感表达与一键多语言翻译。
desc.en: AI avatar video platform that produces studio-grade talking-head videos in minutes, with consistent avatars, multi-angle shooting, precise lip sync and one-click translation.

desc.zh: 智象未来推出的多模态生成平台，官方称自研基础模型覆盖文本、图像、视频与3D模态，提供企业级模型服务接口、营销内容生成与AI影视创作协作能力，面向影视与营销场景。
desc.en: HiDream's multimodal generation platform spanning text, image, video and 3D models, with enterprise model APIs, marketing content generation and AI film collaboration.

desc.zh: AI 原生创意套件，覆盖图像、视频与语音生成，以丰富的预设运镜与特效镜头（Effects、Motion Designer 等）见长，擅长把静态图变成电影感强、传播度高的动态画面。
desc.en: AI-native creative suite for image, video and voice, best known for preset camera moves and effect shots that turn stills into cinematic, shareable motion.

desc.zh: 腾讯混元推出的文生视频能力，官方称其开源视频模型参数规模与性能居开源前列，支持文生视频、原生切镜与连续动作，并提供语音驱动的数字人形象与自动配音能力。
desc.en: Tencent Hunyuan's video generation, whose open-source video models support text-to-video, native shot cuts and continuous motion, plus voice-driven avatars and auto dubbing.

desc.zh: 面向创作者与团队的 AI 视频平台，主打 AI 智能体代剪辑：上传素材、描述需求即可完成粗剪，内置分镜、脚本、时间线与多人协作，适合营销类视频的规模化生产。
desc.en: AI video platform where an agent handles the rough cut: upload footage, describe what you need, and use storyboards, scripts, timelines and team collaboration to scale marketing video.

desc.zh: 字节跳动旗下 AI 创作平台，支持文生图、图生视频与首尾帧控制，与剪映生态打通，生成素材可直接进入剪辑流程，是国内创作者做短视频与图文内容的高频工具。
desc.en: ByteDance's AI creation platform for text-to-image, image-to-video and first/last-frame control, wired into CapCut so generated assets drop straight into your edit.

desc.zh: Kaiber 面向音乐人与视觉创作者，提供 Canvas 工作流、Beat Sync 节拍同步与多模型聚合：上传素材与音乐，几分钟内可产出多条卡点视频，支持风格迁移与口型同步。
desc.en: For musicians and visual artists: a Canvas workflow, beat sync and multi-model aggregation produce several rhythm-locked videos from your footage and track in minutes.

desc.zh: 浏览器里的现代视频编辑器，提供从提示词生成完整视频项目、自动字幕、音频编辑、文字转语音与 Repurpose Studio 切片等能力，官网称全球有超过 3000 万创作者在用。
desc.en: Browser-based video editor that builds full projects from a prompt, with auto subtitles, audio editing, text-to-speech and a repurposing studio.

desc.zh: 快手推出的 AI 视频与图像生成平台，主打原生 4K 视频、动作控制、首尾帧与音画同步能力，支持超长视频分镜并开放开发者 API。
desc.en: Kuaishou's AI video and image platform, known for native 4K video, motion control, first/last frame and audio-visual sync, with long-form storyboarding and a developer API.

desc.zh: Lightricks 推出的 AI 视频制作工作台，覆盖从概念、分镜、风格设定到角色与场景控制的完整制作流程，面向影视团队、广告公司与电视台等专业化生产场景。
desc.en: Lightricks' AI filmmaking workbench covering the whole pipeline from concept, storyboard and style setting to character and scene control — built for studios, agencies and broadcasters.

desc.zh: Luma AI 是创意 AI 平台，旗下 Ray 与 Uni 系列视频模型支持文生视频与图生视频，Ray 3.2 强调逐帧可控的导演级运镜，并提供创意智能体处理端到端创作工作流。
desc.en: Creative AI platform whose Ray and Uni video models handle text-to-video and image-to-video, with frame-level directorial control and creative agents for end-to-end workflows.

desc.zh: 美图推出的AI短片创作工具，支持把想法转为动画短片、上传商品图生成创意广告，并聚合多家大模型生成视频素材，提供从脚本到成片的一站式流程，面向短片与广告制作。
desc.en: Meitu's AI short-film tool that turns ideas into animated shorts and product images into ad videos, aggregating several large models into a script-to-finished-film flow.

desc.zh: 创意 AI 视频平台，主打 idea-to-video，提供 Pika 2.5 模型、创意特效、Pika Agent 与 API 服务，以玩法丰富的特效玩法在社交媒体上广泛传播。
desc.en: Creative AI video platform built around idea-to-video, with the Pika 2.5 model, playful effects, an agent and an API — its effects travel widely on social media.

desc.zh: 爱诗科技推出的 AI 视频生成平台，提供 V6 等自研视频模型，支持文生视频、图生视频、模板特效与角色一致性，并开放 CLI、API 与画布工作流，面向创作者与企业两类场景。
desc.en: AI video platform from AiShi Technology with in-house models supporting text-to-video, image-to-video, template effects and character consistency, plus CLI, API and canvas workflows.

desc.zh: 聚合多款主流视频与图像模型的 AI 创意套件，在一个工作台内完成文生视频、图生视频、数字人、音频与营销素材制作，支持最高 4K 输出，适合不想绑定单一模型生态的创作者。
desc.en: AI creative suite aggregating leading video and image models in one workspace — text-to-video, image-to-video, digital humans, audio and marketing assets at up to 4K.

desc.zh: 以「构建现实世界智能」为核心定位的 AI 创作平台，Runway Creative 一站式生成编辑视频、图像与音频，另有面向开发者的 Dev 与具身智能 Robotics 产品线。
desc.en: AI creation platform framing itself around building real-world intelligence: Creative handles video, image and audio generation and editing, with Dev and Robotics lines alongside.

desc.zh: SkyReels是昆仑万维推出的AI视频生成平台，围绕故事化叙事提供文生视频、图生视频与多模态参考生视频能力，官方称可同时生成画面与声音，并支持跨分镜的角色一致性与情节延续。
desc.en: Kunlun Tech's story-driven video platform with text-to-video, image-to-video and multimodal reference inputs, generating picture and sound together with cross-shot character consistency.

desc.zh: 面向企业的 AI 视频平台，用 AI 数字人与配音生成演播室级视频，支持 160+ 语言，官网称被财富 100 强中九成以上企业用于培训、传播与销售内容生产。
desc.en: Enterprise AI video platform producing studio-quality videos with AI avatars and voiceovers in 160+ languages, used across most of the Fortune 100 for training, comms and sales.

desc.zh: 万兴天幕是万兴科技推出的AI内容创作平台，官方称一句话即可生成视频、图片与音乐，覆盖文生视频、图生视频、视频续写、文生音乐与文生语音等模块，并支持镜头与情绪的精细控制。
desc.en: Wondershare's AI content platform that generates video, images and music from a single sentence, with fine control over shots and mood across text-to-video, video extension and voice.

desc.zh: 书生·筑梦（Vchitect）是上海人工智能实验室推出的视频生成模型，官方称Vchitect 2.0支持5至20秒生成、灵活宽高比与超分插帧，并具备图生视频能力。
desc.en: Shanghai AI Lab's Vchitect video model. Version 2.0 supports 5–20 second generation, flexible aspect ratios, super-resolution and frame interpolation, plus image-to-video.

desc.zh: 面向社媒与营销场景的在线 AI 视频平台，把生成、编辑、配音、字幕合并在一个工作流中，支持口播视频、品牌化模板与自动字幕，官网称服务全球数百万团队。
desc.en: Online AI video platform for social and marketing that merges generation, editing, voiceover and captions into one workflow, with talking-head video and branded templates.

desc.zh: 生数科技推出的 AI 视频生成平台，以多主体参考生视频为核心特色，角色一致性与二次元动画表现尤为出色，被多位 AIGC 导演用于漫剧、广告等商业项目。
desc.en: Shengshu Technology's AI video platform built around multi-subject reference-to-video, strong on character consistency and anime, and used by AIGC directors for commercial projects.

desc.zh: Viggle 是空间生成式 AI 平台，主打无需传统动捕设备的 3D 角色动画：用一段手机视频提取动作并应用到任意角色，可导出到游戏引擎，另提供 Meme Maker 与 API。
desc.en: Spatial generative AI that animates 3D characters from an ordinary phone video — no motion capture rig — with export to game engines, plus a Meme Maker and an API.

desc.zh: 万兴科技推出的营销视频工具，围绕人货场组织创作流程，支持用一句话、一张图或商品链接生成真人带货视频，官方称内置多品类模板并采用虚实分控技术，面向电商营销。
desc.en: Wondershare's marketing video tool organised around person, product and scene: generate presenter-led product videos from a sentence, an image or a product link, using multi-category templates.

desc.zh: 在线设计协作平台，海量模板与正版素材覆盖海报、PPT、简历、社媒图等场景，内置 AI 生成、AI 抠图与企业级品牌管理。
desc.en: Online design and collaboration platform with templates and licensed assets for posters, slides, resumes and social graphics, plus built-in AI generation and background removal.

desc.zh: 国产在线设计与视频编辑器，官网称提供 8000 万图片素材与 100 万+ 模板，支持智能抠图、智能消除、图片变清晰、AI 商品图与去水印等，商用带版权保障。
desc.en: Chinese online design and video editor with 80M stock images and 1M+ templates, offering smart cutout, object removal, unblurring, AI product shots and watermark removal with commercial licensing.

desc.zh: 美图公司推出的电商AI视觉工具，定位为跨境电商的商品图与视频生成平台。可把一张供应商产品图扩成白底主图、场景图与信息图，生成AI模特试穿与商品视频，并支持批量处理与文案翻译。
desc.en: Meitu's e-commerce AI visual tool for cross-border sellers: expand one supplier photo into white-background, lifestyle and infographic shots, generate AI model try-ons and product videos, and batch process or translate copy.

desc.zh: 从创意到上线一步到位的 AI 设计平台，智能体可在画布上直接设计与搭建站点，改动始终可编辑，并内置托管、安全、分析、CMS 与 SEO 能力。
desc.en: AI design platform that takes you from idea to live site, with agents designing directly on the canvas, everything still editable, and hosting, security, analytics, CMS and SEO built in.

desc.zh: 国内在线设计平台，海量模板加 AI 辅助，不会 PS 也能做海报、PPT、电商物料；整合 AI 抠图、去水印、AI 消除、商品精修与视频创作，素材正版授权可商用。
desc.en: Chinese online design platform combining templates with AI assistance so non-designers can make posters, slides and e-commerce assets, with AI cutout, watermark removal and licensed stock.

desc.zh: Prezi 旗下数据可视化工具，可制作交互图表、地图、信息图与报告，支持嵌入与分享，官网称从图表到信息图全流程均可由 AI 辅助完成。
desc.en: Prezi's data visualisation tool for interactive charts, maps, infographics and reports, embeddable and shareable, with AI assistance across the whole flow.

desc.zh: 面向国内设计师的专业级在线 UI 设计工具，支持多人实时协作、原型交互、资源管理与开发标注，兼容 Figma、Sketch、XD 文件格式，浏览器即可使用且永久免费。
desc.en: Professional online UI design tool with real-time collaboration, prototyping, asset management and dev handoff; opens Figma, Sketch and XD files in the browser, free forever.

desc.zh: 面向创作者的 AI 优先设计平台，集成主流图像生成模型、专业编辑工具、样机与精选素材，官网新推 Brand Studio，可在几分钟内产出统一风格的品牌物料。
desc.en: AI-first design platform for creators, combining mainstream image models with professional editing tools, mockups and curated assets, plus a Brand Studio for consistent brand kits.

desc.zh: 在线智能LOGO设计生成器，基于设计原理与历史数据生成标志方案，可输出矢量等多种格式文件，并提供字体商用授权及名片、企业VI、海报、社交素材等配套设计资源。
desc.en: Online logo generator that produces mark concepts from design principles and historical data, exporting vector and other formats with licensed fonts and matching card and VI assets.

desc.zh: AI 驱动的 Logo 与品牌识别设计平台（前身 Logojoy），输入公司名即可生成 Logo 方案，并配套品牌套件与网站，适合创业初期快速建立视觉形象。
desc.en: AI logo and brand identity platform (formerly Logojoy) that generates logo options from your company name, with brand kits and a website to match.

desc.zh: 国产数字界面生产平台，提供AI文图生原型、专业界面设计与设计稿转代码能力，支持产设研在线协同、企业资产管理与企业级权限部署，面向产品设计研发一体化协作场景。
desc.en: Chinese digital interface production platform with AI text-and-image-to-prototype, professional UI design and design-to-code, supporting product-design-engineering collaboration and enterprise asset management.

desc.zh: 美图秀秀官方出品的免费在线设计平台，专注电商与营销场景，一键生成商品图海报、智能抠图换背景，覆盖电商设计、海报、视频、自媒体营销、品牌设计与 PPT。
desc.en: Meitu's free online design platform for e-commerce and marketing — one-click product posters, smart cutout and background replacement across posters, video, social and brand design.

desc.zh: 微软推出的 AI 图形设计工具，用提示词即可生成海报、社交帖子、邀请函与自定义图像，支持 AI 编辑与从零手动设计，覆盖图像、图标、壁纸等丰富模板类型。
desc.en: Microsoft's AI graphic design tool that generates posters, social posts, invitations and custom images from a prompt, with AI editing or manual design from scratch.

desc.zh: 国产智能原型设计与产研协作平台，提供一句话生成多页面原型、AI生成PPT与PRD、流程图与思维导图生成以及设计稿转代码能力，支持多端使用，面向产品团队协作场景。
desc.en: Chinese prototyping and product-engineering collaboration platform that generates multi-page prototypes, slide decks, PRDs, flowcharts and mind maps from a sentence, plus design-to-code.

desc.zh: AI驱动的用户界面设计工具，支持导入典型界面让AI学习设计风格，按文字或图片生成界面与组件，并提供MCP让编码工具理解设计稿生成前端代码，面向产设研协作场景。
desc.en: AI-driven UI design tool that learns your design style from imported interfaces, generates screens and components from text or images, and exposes MCP so coding tools can turn designs into frontend code.

desc.zh: 面向电商的 AI 修图与商品图工作台，可自动抠图、换背景、生成场景图与营销素材，官网定位为「让商品一眼就卖出去」的全套 AI 视觉方案。
desc.en: AI photo editing and product-shot workbench for e-commerce — automatic cutout, background replacement, scene generation and marketing assets.

desc.zh: 老牌信息图与可视化设计平台，官网称服务 3400 万用户，提供 Pikto AI Studio，可把数据快速变成信息图、演示、报告、电子书与视频，无需设计基础。
desc.en: Veteran infographic and visual design platform used by 34M people, with Pikto AI Studio turning data into infographics, presentations, reports and video.

desc.zh: 免费在线 AI 修图与生图工具，集修图、AI 生图/生视频、换脸、去背景与拼图于一体，官网称接入 Flux 等主流图像模型，浏览器打开即用、无需安装。
desc.en: Free online photo editor and image generator in one browser tab — retouching, AI image and video generation, face swap, background removal and collage, powered by models like Flux.

desc.zh: 国产 AI 协同设计工具，集白板、原型、UI 与交付于一体，官网称支持 AI 一键生成 UI 设计稿与 React/Vue 代码，打通设计到开发全链路，可导入 Figma 文件。
desc.en: Collaborative design tool combining whiteboard, prototyping, UI design and developer handoff, with AI generating UI screens and React or Vue code. Opens Figma files.

desc.zh: 最知名的一键去背景工具，上传图片即可全自动抠图、约 5 秒出图，提供批量编辑、API 与插件；官网公告抠图功能将并入 Canva 可画，独立站点 2026 年 12 月起停用。
desc.en: The best-known one-click background remover: upload an image and get a clean cutout in about five seconds, with batch editing, an API and plugins. Folding into Canva; the standalone site retires in December 2026.

desc.zh: 国产在线做图与微信编辑器，官网称提供 175 万套在线模板，覆盖海报、公众号首图、邀请函、小红书封面等场景，支持 AI 生成与多人协作。
desc.en: Chinese online graphics tool and WeChat editor with 1.75M templates covering posters, article headers, invitations and social covers, plus AI generation and multiplayer collaboration.

desc.zh: 面向产品团队的 AI UI 设计工具，可用自然语言与截图生成 App、网页与桌面软件的界面原型，官网称会像用幻灯片一样简单，适合快速验证产品构想。
desc.en: AI UI design tool for product teams that generates web, mobile and desktop interfaces from natural language or a screenshot — as easy as making slides, for rapid concept validation.

desc.zh: 集演示文稿、交互式信息图、设计与视频于一体的可视化内容平台，内置 AI 设计助手，官网主打零设计基础也能产出专业内容与品牌化素材。
desc.en: Visual content platform uniting presentations, interactive infographics, design and video, with a built-in AI design assistant so non-designers can ship professional, on-brand material.

desc.zh: 面向音乐制作人的 AI 音乐工作站，提供歌声合成、声音克隆、AI 乐器与音轨分离，官方称可精确控制音高节奏与情感，并通过插件接入主流宿主。
desc.en: AI music workstation for producers offering singing voice synthesis, voice cloning, AI instruments and stem separation, with precise control over pitch, timing and emotion through a DAW plugin.

desc.zh: AI 音乐生成助手，官网主打「几秒钟生成 AI 歌曲」，长期以古典与影视配乐见长，可注册免费账号试用，适合需要管弦与情绪化配乐的创作者。
desc.en: AI music composer known for classical and cinematic scores — generate a track in seconds from a free account, aimed at creators who need orchestral, emotive backing music.

desc.zh: 免版税的 AI 背景音乐生成工具，面向视频、播客与游戏场景，可按需求生成并自定义曲目，官网称已有 200 万+ 创作者生成超过 1500 万首曲目。
desc.en: Royalty-free AI background music generator for video, podcasts and games. More than 2M creators have generated over 15M tracks.

desc.zh: 生成式 AI 音乐工具，官网主打「没做过音乐也能创作原创歌曲」，可一键生成歌曲并分享、通过平台发行获取收益，适合零基础用户体验 AI 作曲。
desc.en: Generative music tool for people who have never made music — create an original song in one click, share it, and release it through the platform to earn royalties.

desc.zh: 以功能谱为核心的一站式移动音乐工作站，集成 AI 作曲、AI 编曲与 AI 演唱，输入和弦即可生成编曲、输入简谱即可生成歌声，并支持导出对接专业宿主。
desc.en: Mobile music workstation built around chord charts, combining AI composition, arrangement and singing: enter chords to get an arrangement, enter notation to get vocals, then export to a DAW.

desc.zh: 面向长音视频的 AI 分析平台，粘贴链接即可在线转录、提炼摘要，支持百种语言实时字幕翻译、生成闪卡测验，还能一键产出公众号与小红书二创文案。
desc.en: AI analysis platform for long audio and video: paste a link to transcribe and summarise, get real-time subtitle translation across 100 languages, flashcards and quizzes, plus repurposed copy for social platforms.

desc.zh: 字节跳动旗下的 AI 音乐创作产品，输入一句灵感或歌词即可生成含人声的完整歌曲，支持纯音乐、参考音乐改编与曲风心情音色选择。
desc.en: ByteDance's AI music product — type a line of inspiration or lyrics and get a finished song with vocals, with options for instrumentals, reference-based remixing, and genre, mood and timbre selection.

desc.zh: 面向制作人的录音棚级 AI 音频工具，可用 AI 人声生成器克隆音色、以任意风格演唱与演奏乐器，并提供桌面端与面向音乐工作流的工具集。
desc.en: Studio-grade AI audio tools for producers: clone voices with an AI vocal generator, sing or play instruments in any style, with a desktop app and a suite built for music workflows.

desc.zh: 专业级 AI 人声与乐器分离工具，上传音频或视频即可在数秒内提取出高质量的人声、伴奏与各类乐器音轨，适合翻唱、Remix 与素材再利用。
desc.en: Professional AI stem separation: upload audio or video and extract high-quality vocals, instrumentals and individual instruments in seconds — useful for covers, remixes and sample reuse.

desc.zh: 面向创作者、艺人与品牌的 AI 音乐平台，可生成、重混、母带处理与分轨，产出免版税的音乐与采样，官网强调其音频引擎的版权安全性。
desc.en: AI music platform for creators, artists and brands to generate, remix, master and split tracks, producing royalty-free music and samples on a copyright-safe audio engine.

desc.zh: AI 音乐生成与流媒体平台，可从文字提示生成面向视频、播客与应用的免版税音乐，官网近期还推出了面向播客的编辑工具，适合需要长时间背景音的场景。
desc.en: AI music generation and streaming platform that turns text prompts into royalty-free music for video, podcasts and apps, with an editor for podcasters and support for long ambient sessions.

desc.zh: AI 音乐生成平台，可从文字提示生成完整歌曲、人声、歌词与伴奏，官网提供 Studio、工具库与创作奖励活动，支持多语言界面与视频创作。
desc.en: AI music platform that generates complete songs with vocals, lyrics and backing from a text prompt, offering a studio, tool library and creator rewards with a multilingual interface.

desc.zh: AI 人声歌曲生成工具，官网称可用 10 万+ 音色或克隆自己的声音来制作 AI 翻唱与原创歌曲，并提供 API，是 AI 翻唱二创圈的常用工具之一。
desc.en: AI vocal song maker: produce covers and original tracks using 100k+ voices or a clone of your own, and call it through an API. A staple of the AI cover community.

desc.zh: AI 音乐生成与编辑工具，可生成原创歌曲、节拍、伴奏与音效，并支持分轨提取、换声与音频增强，界面提供中文，适合中文创作者快速上手。
desc.en: AI music generation and editing — create original songs, beats, backing tracks and sound effects, with stem extraction, voice swapping and audio enhancement. Chinese interface available.

desc.zh: 网易云音乐旗下的 AI 音乐创作工具，主打宝藏词人、乐评灵感、原声演唱与一键发行，官方称可打通作词、作曲、演唱与发行环节，面向音乐创作爱好者与内容创作者。
desc.en: NetEase Cloud Music's AI songwriting tool, covering lyrics inspiration, arrangement, performance and one-click release for hobbyists and content creators.

desc.zh: 起源于开源项目的 AI 音乐生成工具，以扩散模型生成器乐片段与循环见长，据公开报道其已被 Google 收购，官网现跳转至 Google Flow Music。
desc.en: Started as an open-source project and known for generating instrumental loops with diffusion models. Reportedly acquired by Google; the site now redirects to Google Flow Music.

desc.zh: 趣丸科技推出的 AI 音乐创作应用，基于自研天谱乐大模型支持文字、图片与视频生成音乐，并提供三键成曲、哼唱成曲与多声库 AI 演唱。
desc.en: AI music creation app from Qutuan Tech, built on its in-house Tianpule model: generate music from text, images or video, with three-key songwriting, hum-to-song and multi-voice AI singing.

desc.zh: 昆仑万维基于天工大模型打造的 AI 音乐生成产品，官方称可实现乐器、人声与旋律端到端生成，支持歌词段落控制、多种曲风与方言演唱。
desc.en: Kunlun Tech's AI music product built on the Tiangong model, generating instruments, vocals and melody end to end, with lyric section control and support for multiple genres and dialects.

desc.zh: 上海音虫推出的国产编曲录音软件，内置 600 多个虚拟乐器与经典乐段，支持 AI 编曲与 VST、VST3 插件，官方称是上海市教委空中课堂指定教学软件。
desc.en: Chinese arrangement and recording software with 600+ virtual instruments and classic riffs, AI arrangement, and VST and VST3 plugin support.

desc.zh: 面向品牌与创作者的 AI 音乐平台，官网主打由制作人参与、由合规训练的 AI 辅助生成原创音乐，可规模化产出并授权商用，适合企业与内容团队。
desc.en: AI music platform for brands and creators, with producer-involved, compliance-trained generation of original music that can be licensed commercially at scale.

desc.zh: AI 音乐生成工具，几秒钟生成免版税节拍并可逐件调整乐器、下载分轨，官网强调不使用抓取歌曲、版权清晰，适合创作者与商用项目。
desc.en: AI music generator that produces royalty-free beats in seconds, lets you adjust instruments track by track and download stems, with clearly sourced copyright for commercial work.

desc.zh: 面向音乐与声音创作的音频工具箱，官网强调模型与应用可定制且商用安全，支持全混音与多轨输出，可按指定时长生成音乐与音效素材。
desc.en: Audio toolbox for music and sound design with customisable, commercially safe models and apps, supporting full mixes, multi-track output and generation at a specified duration.

desc.zh: AI 音乐生成平台，用一句提示词即可生成带人声与伴奏的完整歌曲，每天免费额度 10 首，支持分轨导出到 DAW 与付费商用授权，并提供专业编辑工具与社区分享。
desc.en: AI music platform that turns one prompt into a complete song with vocals and backing. Ten free songs a day, stem export to your DAW, paid commercial licensing, and pro editing tools.

desc.zh: 腾讯音乐天琴实验室的音乐生产技术平台，提供音乐分离、MIR 音乐信息计算、未音 AI 作歌与智能吉他曲谱，覆盖从素材处理到 AI 创作与发行。
desc.en: Tencent Music's music production platform, offering source separation, music information retrieval, AI songwriting and smart guitar tablature — from raw material to creation and release.

desc.zh: AI 音乐生成平台，用一句话描述即可生成任意风格与情绪的完整歌曲，支持续写、局部编辑、混音与上传素材，还能发现并分享社区作品。
desc.en: AI music platform that generates complete songs in any style or mood from a single description, with extension, local editing, mixing, uploads and a community of shared tracks.

desc.zh: 网易云音乐与小冰合作推出的 AI 歌声合成软件，输入曲谱即可在几秒内生成演唱，提供音高、力度与咬字等多维参数调节，并有洛天依等虚拟歌手声线。
desc.en: AI singing synthesis software from NetEase Cloud Music and Xiaoice: feed in notation and get a performance in seconds, with control over pitch, dynamics and diction using virtual singer voices.

desc.zh: 标贝科技是AI数据基础设施服务商，围绕语音、视觉、文本与大模型场景，提供数据采集、标注到数据集交付的全流程服务，并具备ASR、TTS与音色克隆等语音模型能力。
desc.en: AI data infrastructure provider covering collection, annotation and dataset delivery for speech, vision, text and large-model use cases, alongside ASR, TTS and voice-cloning models.

desc.zh: 火山引擎的语音大模型产品线，覆盖语音合成、声音复刻、语音识别、实时语音与音频生成等能力，官方称提供 400+ 音色、30+ 语种，面向企业支持 API 与 SDK 接入。
desc.en: ByteDance's Volcano Engine speech model line covering synthesis, voice cloning, recognition, real-time speech and audio generation — 400+ voices and 30+ languages, with API and SDK access.

desc.zh: 面向短视频解说的 AI 配音平台，官方称提供多角色、多赛道路线的热门声音，支持声音克隆、文案提取、自动对轴与人声分离，并内置声音转换、音效变声等创作工具。
desc.en: AI dubbing platform for short-video narration, offering character voices across popular styles, voice cloning, script extraction, auto alignment and vocal separation, plus voice conversion and effects.

desc.zh: AI 语音平台，提供录音棚级文字转语音与语音克隆，官网称拥有 200 万+ 音色、覆盖 8 种语言，主打可实时、带情感控制的语音模型。
desc.en: AI voice platform with studio-grade text-to-speech and voice cloning. Two million voices across eight languages, built around real-time models with emotional control.

desc.zh: 浏览器里的免费音频工具集，除文字转语音外还提供语音转文字、人声分离、语音增强与在线音频编辑，适合不想装软件、偶尔处理音频的用户。
desc.en: Free browser-based audio toolkit: text-to-speech plus speech-to-text, vocal separation, voice enhancement and online audio editing — no software installation needed.

desc.zh: 网易见外是网易自营的智能转写翻译平台，提供视频智能字幕、音频转写翻译、会议同传与文档翻译等能力，覆盖影视综艺、演讲课程、展会会议等场景，官方称累计翻译量已超过1亿字。
desc.en: NetEase's transcription and translation platform covering smart video subtitles, audio transcription and translation, live meeting interpretation and document translation, with over 100M characters translated to date.

desc.zh: 云知声推出的 AI 配音与声音克隆平台，官方称提供不同性别、口音与语种的 AI 发音人，支持文字转语音、AI 文案创作与专属声音克隆，可快速完成短视频、有声书配音。
desc.en: Unisound's AI dubbing and voice cloning platform, offering voices across genders, accents and languages for text-to-speech, AI copywriting and custom voice clones — fast dubbed audio for short video and audiobooks.

desc.zh: MiniMax 的语音与音乐生成平台，官方称由 Speech 2.6 与 Music 2.0 驱动，提供语音合成、音色设计、声音克隆与音乐创作，并支持人声提取与 API 接入。
desc.en: MiniMax's speech and music platform, powered by Speech 2.6 and Music 2.0: speech synthesis, voice design, voice cloning and music creation, with vocal extraction and API access.

desc.zh: 在线 AI 配音平台，官方称提供 1500+ 声音风格、800+ 音色，覆盖 19 种语言与 15 种方言，支持逐句试听、多音字、停顿重读等近 20 项调音，并可克隆声音与云剪辑。
desc.en: Online AI dubbing platform with 1500+ voice styles and 800+ timbres across 19 languages and 15 dialects, sentence-by-sentence preview, around 20 tuning controls including polyphone and stress, plus voice cloning and cloud editing.

desc.zh: 面向企业与开发者的 AI 语音平台，提供自然语音生成与对话式智能体部署，官网称被 1000 万以上开发者、企业与创作者使用，并提供 TTS API。
desc.en: AI voice platform for enterprises and developers offering natural speech generation and conversational agent deployment, used by 10M+ developers, businesses and creators, with a TTS API.

desc.zh: 老牌文字转语音工具，官网称全球超 1000 万用户，用 AI 语音把任意文本变成自然音频，分个人版、商业版与教育版，适合阅读辅助、无障碍与配音制作。
desc.en: Long-running text-to-speech tool with 10M+ users worldwide, turning any text into natural audio across personal, commercial and education tiers — for reading support, accessibility and voiceover.

desc.zh: 面向影视与媒体制作的专业语音生成工具，官网强调服务真实制作流程、可免费测试并灵活集成，已开放文字转语音 API，适合高要求的声音替换项目。
desc.en: Professional speech generation for film and media production, built for real production pipelines with free testing and flexible integration, and now a text-to-speech API.

desc.zh: 主打把任何文本读给你听的 TTS 助手，官网称覆盖网页、Chrome 插件与 iOS/Android/Mac/Windows，提供语音输入、配音与声音克隆等能力。
desc.en: Text-to-speech assistant that reads anything aloud across the web, a Chrome extension and iOS, Android, Mac and Windows apps, with voice input, dubbing and voice cloning.

desc.zh: 在线文字转语音平台，官网称提供 580+ 优质 AI 音色、支持 60+ 语言，单次可处理较长文本并提供商用授权，同时开放 API 供开发者调用。
desc.en: Online text-to-speech platform with 580+ AI voices across 60+ languages, long-form input, commercial licensing and an API for developers.

desc.zh: 面向创作者的 AI 音视频一体化工坊，覆盖 AI 音乐、AI 视频分镜与文字转语音配音，官网主打「音乐、视频、配音一个平台搞定」，并提供 API。
desc.en: Creator-focused AI audio and video workshop covering AI music, AI video storyboards and text-to-speech dubbing — music, video and voice from one platform, with an API.

desc.zh: 免费在线文字转语音工具，官网称支持 140+ 语言，可把文本转成自然语音并下载 MP3，同时提供语音转文字与付费套餐，适合轻量、临时的配音需求。
desc.en: Free online text-to-speech tool supporting 140+ languages with MP3 download, plus speech-to-text and paid plans for lightweight, one-off voiceover needs.

desc.zh: 免费在线文字转语音工具（马克配音），官方称支持 50 多种语言与 300 多种语音风格，可在线试听并下载 MP3/WAV，每周有免费字符额度，并声明生成内容可商用。
desc.en: Free online text-to-speech tool supporting 50+ languages and 300+ voice styles, with in-browser preview, MP3 and WAV download, weekly free character quotas and commercial use permitted.

desc.zh: 表现力见长的 AI 语音生成器，官网称提供 700+ AI 音色，可调节情绪、语速与力度，部分音色来自真实配音演员授权，面向创作者、开发者与企业。
desc.en: Expressive AI voice generator with 700+ AI voices and control over emotion, pace and emphasis. Some voices are licensed from real voice actors; built for creators, developers and enterprises.

desc.zh: 面向音乐人与创作者的 AI 人声平台，提供 AI 演唱人声、文字转语音、语音转换与声音克隆，官网称可为代理机构、音乐人、市场人员与创作者产出拟真人声。
desc.en: AI vocal platform for musicians and creators: AI singing vocals, text-to-speech, voice conversion and cloning, producing near-human voices for agencies, artists and marketers.

desc.zh: 在线文字转语音工具，官网称提供 2000+ AI 音色、覆盖 130 种语言，可导出 MP3/WAV，适合 YouTube 短视频等场景，另有语音克隆、语音转语音与语音转文字。
desc.en: Online text-to-speech tool with 2000+ AI voices across 130 languages and MP3 or WAV export, aimed at YouTube and short video, plus voice cloning and speech-to-text.

desc.zh: 企业级 AI 语音生成平台，官网主打「最真实的 AI 声音」，提供多种方言与制作风格的配音音色，强调安全合规，适合企业的专业旁白产出。
desc.en: Enterprise AI voice platform promising the most realistic AI voices, with voiceover timbres across dialects and production styles, built with security and compliance in mind.

desc.zh: 超拟真 AI 语音合成与瞬时克隆平台（原 Reecho 睿声），官方称自研文生语音模型支持 30+ 语言与方言，最短 3 秒样本即可克隆声音，并提供声音市场与低延迟 API。
desc.en: Hyper-realistic AI speech synthesis and instant voice cloning (formerly Reecho), with in-house models covering 30+ languages and dialects, cloning from as little as three seconds of audio, plus a voice marketplace and low-latency API.

desc.zh: 科大讯飞旗下一站式 AI 配音与数字人平台，提供超拟人文字转语音、卡通数字人视频与形象、声音定制，官方称覆盖教育培训、新闻媒体、企业营销等场景，服务超千万创作者。
desc.en: iFlytek's one-stop AI dubbing and digital human platform, offering near-human text-to-speech, cartoon digital human video and avatars, and custom voices for training, media and marketing.

desc.zh: 扣子是字节跳动旗下的一站式 AI 开发平台，无需复杂指令即可搭建智能体与可视化工作流，可操作电脑和手机直接交付结果，覆盖 PPT、数据分析、小程序与网页开发等场景。
desc.en: ByteDance's one-stop AI development platform: build agents and visual workflows without complex instructions, then let them operate a computer or phone to deliver results — slide decks, data analysis, mini programs and web apps.

desc.zh: DeepSeek 是深度求索的大模型系列，官方开源 V4、R1 等前沿模型，提供网页版、手机应用与开放 API，主打高性价比与原生多模态视觉理解能力。
desc.en: DeepSeek's model family, with frontier models such as V4 and R1 released openly, plus a web app, mobile app and open API built around cost efficiency and native multimodal vision.

desc.zh: Dify 是面向生产级 Agentic 工作流的开源 LLM 应用开发平台，在统一画布上搭建 Agent、知识管道（RAG）与工作流，支持云端、VPC 或自托管部署。
desc.en: Open-source LLM application platform for production-grade agentic workflows: build agents, RAG knowledge pipelines and workflows on one canvas, deployed to cloud, VPC or self-hosted.

desc.zh: 字节跳动推出的 AI 智能助手，整合对话问答、写作、翻译、PPT、图像与视频生成等能力，支持语音实时交流，官方称登录即可免费使用，并提供网页版与电脑客户端。
desc.en: ByteDance's AI assistant combining chat, writing, translation, slide decks, and image and video generation with real-time voice interaction. Free once signed in, on web and desktop.

desc.zh: 智谱（Z.ai）的大模型体系，GLM 系列支持 1M 上下文与前沿编程能力，配套 ZCode 编程工具、AutoGLM 智能体及全模态 MaaS API 服务。
desc.en: Zhipu's GLM model family with 1M-token context and frontier coding ability, alongside the ZCode coding tool, AutoGLM agents and a full-modality MaaS API.

desc.zh: 科大讯飞推出的全场景 AI 智能体平台（现 AStudio），不止对话，可描述目标自主调度工具完成网页开发、数据分析、财报解读与代码重构，支持权限管控与企业协同。
desc.en: iFlytek's full-scenario AI agent platform (now AStudio): describe a goal and it autonomously orchestrates tools to build web pages, analyse data, read financial reports or refactor code, with permission controls for teams.

desc.zh: Kimi 是月之暗面（Moonshot AI）推出的 AI 助手，官网当前以「K3 上线，专为智能体编程与知识工作打造」为主标题。
desc.en: Moonshot AI's assistant, currently headlined by K3 and built for agentic coding and knowledge work, with long-context handling, deep research, agent swarms, goal mode, slide generation and scheduled tasks.

desc.zh: 美团自研大模型的官方对话平台，集深度思考、联网搜索与图片视频生成于一体，支持深度研究，并开放 API 与手机应用，方便个人和开发者接入使用。
desc.en: Meituan's in-house model chat platform, combining deep reasoning, web search, and image and video generation, with deep research, an open API and a mobile app.

desc.zh: Merlin 是一款浏览器 AI 助手扩展，可在任意网页呼出侧边栏对话、一键总结长文与视频内容，支持划词解释改写，并聚合多个主流大模型供随时切换。
desc.en: Browser AI assistant extension: summon a sidebar chat on any page, summarise long articles and videos in one click, explain or rewrite selected text, and switch between several leading models.

desc.zh: 面向个人与团队的私有 AI 工作台，把私有工作区、受限 Agent、统一模型网关与可控知识库整合成一套系统，支持本地与云端模型，兼顾效率与数据可控。
desc.en: Private AI workbench for individuals and teams, unifying private workspaces, scoped agents, a model gateway and a controllable knowledge base across local and cloud models.

desc.zh: 360 旗下纳米AI，主打多智能体蜂群，集成 DeepSeek、智脑、通义千问等十余家大模型与 MCP 工具箱，支持智能体、深度思考、AI 写作、研究报告与 PPT 生成等任务。
desc.en: 360's Nami AI, built around multi-agent swarms and integrating a dozen model providers plus an MCP toolbox for agents, deep reasoning, AI writing, research reports and slide generation.

desc.zh: Quora 旗下 AI 聊天聚合平台，在一个界面里与 GPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok、Kimi 等数千个模型私聊或群聊，无需订阅各家服务，适合横向对比模型回答质量。
desc.en: Quora's AI chat aggregator: talk to thousands of models including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and Kimi in one interface, privately or in group chats, without subscribing to each service.

desc.zh: 阿里通义千问官方统一平台，同时服务普通用户与开发者，可一站式访问 Qwen 系列开源与闭源模型，覆盖对话、图像与视频理解、图像生成编辑、文档处理与语音视频对话。
desc.en: Alibaba's official Qwen platform for users and developers alike, giving one-stop access to the Qwen family across chat, image and video understanding, image generation and editing, document processing and voice or video conversation.

desc.zh: 阶跃星辰推出的智能体平台，主打从 Coding 到 Agent 皆可构建，提供开放平台与 Studio，模型原生适配办公、代码与 Agent 工作流，支持多模态理解与开源权重部署。
desc.en: StepFun's agent platform, built for everything from coding to agents, offering an open platform and Studio with models natively tuned for office, code and agent workflows, plus multimodal understanding and open-weight deployment.

desc.zh: 昆仑万维天工，定位具备 DeepResearch 能力的超级智能体，通过专家与技能体系一键生成 AI 文档、PPT、表格，也支持网页、图像、视频、有声书、绘本等创意内容创作。
desc.en: Kunlun Tech's Tiangong, positioned as a super agent with deep research capability: generate documents, slide decks and spreadsheets in one click through its expert and skill system, plus web pages, images, video, audiobooks and picture books.

desc.zh: 把小红书运营、抖音运营、公众号编辑、视频制作等岗位做成「下载即上岗」的 AI 员工，桌面端运行，先理解你的业务，再完成从调研策划到内容交付的整套工作。
desc.en: Packages roles such as Xiaohongshu operator, Douyin operator, WeChat editor and video producer into AI employees you deploy. The desktop app learns your business first, then delivers research, planning and content end to end.

desc.zh: 通义是阿里云通义实验室的大模型系列：千问大语言模型覆盖语言、视觉与音频理解及 Agent 能力，万相负责图像、视频与声音生成，并长期开源 Qwen 系列。
desc.en: Alibaba Cloud's Tongyi model family: Qwen handles language, vision and audio understanding plus agent capabilities, while Wanxiang covers image, video and sound generation. The Qwen series is released openly.

desc.zh: 文心是百度旗下的一站式 AI 助手，主打办公学习场景，覆盖文字创作、图片与音乐生成、AI 阅读、文献速读、PPT 生成与海量智能体应用，登录后可多端同步。
desc.en: Baidu's all-in-one AI assistant focused on work and study: writing, image and music generation, AI reading, literature summarising, slide generation and a large library of agents, synced across devices after sign-in.

desc.zh: 讯飞星火是科大讯飞推出的认知智能大模型，覆盖百科问答、内容写作、图像生成、PPT、代码、录音纪要、精准翻译与拍照解题，并提供星火 API 供开发者接入。
desc.en: iFlytek Spark is the company's cognitive large model, covering Q&A, content writing, image generation, slide decks, code, meeting notes, translation and photo-based problem solving, with an API for developers.

desc.zh: 智谱推出的高级 AI 对话与 Agent 平台，官网当前以 GLM-5.3-Flash 为主打模型，官方定位是「Advanced AI Chatbot & Agent」——快速、智能、可靠。
desc.en: Zhipu's advanced AI chat and agent platform, currently headlined by GLM-5.3-Flash and positioned simply as a fast, intelligent, reliable chatbot and agent.

desc.zh: 智谱 AI 的大模型开放平台，内置智能体市场，可一键接入 API 直连生产环境，配套联网搜索、MCP 与知识库能力，与 GLM 系列旗舰模型深度打通，适合构建可信智能体应用。
desc.en: Zhipu's large-model open platform with a built-in agent marketplace, one-click API access to production, and web search, MCP and knowledge base capabilities tightly integrated with the GLM flagship models.

desc.zh: Airtable 是无代码平台，用智能表格统一数据与协作，并构建企业级 AI 工作流、应用与代理，内置 Omni。官网称 50 万+ 团队使用，支持主流模型且客户数据不用于训练。
desc.en: No-code platform that unifies data and collaboration in smart tables, then builds enterprise AI workflows, apps and agents on top. Used by 500k+ teams, with customer data excluded from training.

desc.zh: 专为 PDF 而生的 AI 问答工具，上传即得摘要，可提问并给出页码引用，支持多文件同聊与任意语言，还能与文件、视频、网站对话，配套 AI 写作与检测工具。
desc.en: AI question answering built for PDFs: upload for an instant summary, ask questions with page-level citations, chat across multiple files in any language, and talk to documents, videos or websites.

desc.zh: ClickUp 是号称「一个应用替代多个软件」的办公平台，整合任务、文档、目标与聊天，内置 Brain 系列 AI、AI 代理、会议纪要、写作与问答。免费版永久可用、无需信用卡。
desc.en: Work platform aiming to replace several tools at once — tasks, docs, goals and chat — with Brain AI, AI agents, meeting notes, writing and Q&A. Free forever, no credit card.

desc.zh: 面向建筑师与工程师的 AI 原生平台。官方观点很直接：这个行业今天在用的软件「已是几十年前的东西、难用、为前 AI 时代而建」，自 2021 年起 Cogram 就致力于构建替代方案——让领先的事务所用它来交付项目。
desc.en: AI-native platform for architects and engineers, built since 2021 on the view that the industry's incumbent software was made for a pre-AI era. Leading practices use it to deliver projects.

desc.zh: 在后台运行的邮件 AI 助手，学习你的行文习惯，自动归类来信并起草可直接发送的回复，一键安装、免费试用，让处理邮件变成审核与发送。
desc.en: Email AI assistant that runs in the background: it learns your writing style, triages incoming mail and drafts replies ready to send, turning email into review and send.

desc.zh: Fathom 是 AI 会议记要工具，自动录制、转录并总结 Zoom、Google Meet 与 Teams 通话，个人版永久免费，支持 ChatGPT、Claude 等集成。
desc.en: AI meeting notes tool that records, transcribes and summarises Zoom, Google Meet and Teams calls. Free forever for individuals, with ChatGPT and Claude integrations.

desc.zh: 会议 AI 助手，转写准确率标称 95%，支持 100+ 语言、说话人识别与自动语言检测，自动生成摘要与行动项，并可跨历史会议检索对话。
desc.en: Meeting AI assistant with a claimed 95% transcription accuracy across 100+ languages, speaker identification, automatic language detection, summaries and action items, and a searchable conversation history.

desc.zh: AI 设计伙伴工具，无需设计或编码经验即可生成演示文稿、网站、文档、社媒图与图形，支持导出 PPT/PDF，并提供 API 编程调用。
desc.en: AI design partner that produces presentations, websites, documents, social posts and graphics without design or coding skills, exportable to PPT and PDF, with a programmable API.

desc.zh: Glean 是企业级 AI 平台，连接公司内部的 Slack、Drive、Jira 等数据源，提供企业搜索、知识问答与可编排智能体，强调权限感知与安全合规。
desc.en: Enterprise AI platform connecting internal sources such as Slack, Drive and Jira to deliver enterprise search, knowledge answers and orchestrated agents, with permission awareness and compliance built in.

desc.zh: 讯飞听见是科大讯飞旗下智慧办公平台，提供语音转文字、录音整理、AI 写作、视频转写加字幕与多语种同传翻译，企业版支持 API、SDK 与私有化部署。
desc.en: iFlytek's smart office platform covering speech-to-text, recording organisation, AI writing, video transcription with subtitles and multilingual simultaneous interpretation, with API, SDK and on-premise options.

desc.zh: 面向团队的会议协作工作区，支持会议录制、自动转写与纪要生成，把每次会议的产出集中存放、随时检索，帮助团队成员会后对齐信息、跟进行动项。
desc.en: Team meeting workspace that records calls, transcribes them automatically and generates notes, keeping every meeting's output in one searchable place so people can align and follow up afterwards.

desc.zh: Make 是可视化 AI 自动化平台，用无代码方式构建并编排跨越 3000+ 应用与 AI 智能体的工作流，覆盖营销、销售、运营、财务与 IT 等场景，免费版可供试用。
desc.en: Visual AI automation platform for building and orchestrating no-code workflows across 3000+ apps and AI agents, spanning marketing, sales, operations, finance and IT. Free tier available.

desc.zh: 微软 AI 助手，可聊天问答、联网搜索、辅助写作与头脑风暴、生成图像。免费版无需订阅即可在 Web 与移动端使用，Copilot Pro 优先用更强模型与更快出图。
desc.en: Microsoft's AI assistant for chat, web search, writing help, brainstorming and image generation. The free tier works on web and mobile; Copilot Pro adds stronger models and faster image generation.

desc.zh: monday.com 是 AI 工作平台，把人与 AI 代理放进同一工作流，可建营销、IT、销售等代理，含会议助手、研究、报表与流程优化。免费版不限时长、无需信用卡。
desc.en: An AI work platform that puts people and AI agents in the same workflow, with agents for marketing, IT and sales plus meeting assistance, research, reporting and process improvement. Free and unlimited, no card.

desc.zh: 把 AI 能力与业务流程结合的开源工作流自动化平台，可视化画布搭建同时保留写代码空间，Agent 推理全程可在画布追溯，支持 500+ 集成，可自托管部署。
desc.en: Open-source workflow automation combining AI with business processes: build visually on a canvas while still writing code, trace every agent reasoning step, and use 500+ integrations. Self-hostable.

desc.zh: 用自然语言一步步描述任务，即可自动生成自动化代码并在云端运行的工作流工具；由 OpenAI 与 ChatGPT 驱动，可对接数千个服务，无需学习复杂工具即可上手。
desc.en: Describe a task step by step in plain language and it generates the automation code and runs it in the cloud. Powered by OpenAI and ChatGPT, connecting to thousands of services with no complex tooling to learn.

desc.zh: Notta 是 AI 会议与录音转写工具，支持 58 种语言转录与翻译，自动生成摘要、PPT 与信息图，覆盖线上会议、线下访谈与导入文件等多种场景。
desc.en: AI meeting and recording transcription supporting 58 languages with translation, automatically generating summaries, slide decks and infographics across online meetings, offline interviews and imported files.

desc.zh: AI 会议助手：实时转写每场会议，生成自动摘要、洞察与行动项，支持会议中实时聊天，把历史会议沉淀为可检索、可问答的会话式知识库，并连接常用应用驱动工作流。
desc.en: AI meeting assistant that transcribes every meeting live and generates summaries, insights and action items, with in-meeting chat and a searchable, queryable archive of past conversations.

desc.zh: Read AI 是跨会议、邮件、消息与文件的 AI 效率助手，实时转录并自动生成摘要与行动项，还支持在全部工作内容中统一搜索答案，让团队随时信息同步。
desc.en: AI productivity assistant spanning meetings, email, messages and files: live transcription with automatic summaries and action items, plus unified search for answers across everything you work on.

desc.zh: 石墨文档是国内云端 Office 协同办公平台，提供文档、表格、幻灯片、思维导图等九大套件，支持多人实时协作、知识沉淀与私有化部署，服务超 85 万家企业。
desc.en: Cloud office suite with nine products including documents, spreadsheets, slides and mind maps, supporting real-time collaboration, knowledge capture and private deployment. Used by 850k+ companies.

desc.zh: AI 业务应用构建平台：一句话生成 CRM、看板、客户门户等可运行应用，由 AI 智能体与自动化工作流驱动，内置大量可克隆模板，免费起步无需信用卡，项目与任务管理能力依旧保留。
desc.en: AI business app builder: describe a CRM, board or client portal and get a running app driven by AI agents and automated workflows, with a template library. Free to start, no credit card.

desc.zh: tl;dv 是 AI 会议记要工具，自动录制、转录并总结 Zoom、Google Meet 与 Teams 通话，支持 30+ 语言，并可自动更新 CRM 与跟进邮件。
desc.en: AI meeting recorder that captures, transcribes and summarises Zoom, Google Meet and Teams calls in 30+ languages, and can update your CRM and follow-up emails automatically.

desc.zh: 早期以一句话生成叙事式演示走红的 AI 工具，官网现已下线、产品停止服务，团队已转向新方向；同类需求可改用 Gamma、Canva 等仍在服务的演示工具。
desc.en: An early AI tool that popularised one-prompt narrative presentations. The site is now offline and the product discontinued as the team moved on — for similar needs, try Gamma or Canva.

desc.zh: 阿里云通义听悟是聚焦音视频内容的工作学习 AI 助手，官方称依托大模型帮助用户记录、整理和分析音视频内容，可做实时语音转文字、同步翻译、智能总结与播客链接转写。
desc.en: Alibaba Cloud's AI assistant for audio and video content, helping users record, organise and analyse media with live speech-to-text, simultaneous translation, smart summaries and podcast link transcription.

desc.zh: 字节跳动 AI 办公平台，支持自动生成 PPT、数据分析与深度研究，可调用飞书、微信、钉钉等插件，多端协同，已接入豆包、DeepSeek、Kimi 等模型。
desc.en: ByteDance's AI office platform for automatic slide generation, data analysis and deep research, with plugins for Feishu, WeChat and DingTalk, multi-device sync, and models including Doubao, DeepSeek and Kimi.

desc.zh: 腾讯出品的 AI 办公智能体工作台，能自主规划并调用工具交付多模态任务结果，支持多 Agent 并行，打通腾讯文档、微信、企业微信等生态，覆盖研究、文档、设计与开发场景。
desc.en: Tencent's AI office agent workspace: it plans, calls tools and delivers multimodal results, runs multiple agents in parallel, and connects Tencent Docs, WeChat and WeCom across research, documents, design and development.

desc.zh: 金山办公的 AI 助手，以 WPS 灵犀为统一入口，在 WPS 内完成文档写作与润色、PPT 大纲生成、表格公式、全文总结与文档问答，网页版功能有限，完整体验需下载客户端。
desc.en: Kingsoft Office's AI assistant, entered through WPS Lingxi: document drafting and polishing, slide outlines, spreadsheet formulas, full-text summaries and document Q&A inside WPS. The complete experience needs the desktop client.

desc.zh: Xmind 是思维导图与 AI 头脑风暴工具，支持 Web、桌面与移动端，提供 AI 生成、甘特图、矩阵等多种结构，并具备 ISO 27001 与 SOC 2 安全认证。
desc.en: Mind mapping and AI brainstorming tool for web, desktop and mobile, with AI generation and multiple structures such as Gantt and matrix. ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certified.

desc.zh: 语雀是蚂蚁集团旗下的在线文档与知识库工具，自研编辑器支持文档、画板、工作表与数据表，兼容 Office 与 Markdown。多人异步协作、像书一样沉淀知识库。
desc.en: Ant Group's online document and knowledge base tool, with a self-built editor for documents, whiteboards, sheets and data tables that also handles Office and Markdown files.

desc.zh: Zapier 是连接 9000+ 应用的自动化与 AI 编排平台，可搭建工作流、AI 代理与 MCP/SDK 集成；代理能跨应用执行动作。官网称受 300 万+ 企业信赖。
desc.en: Automation and AI orchestration platform connecting 9000+ apps, for building workflows, AI agents and MCP or SDK integrations that act across applications. Trusted by 3M+ businesses.

desc.zh: AudioPen 是一款语音转文字并自动重写润色的 AI 笔记工具，官方称被 20 万人使用，支持多风格输出、多端同步，帮你把口头想法整理成干净文字。
desc.en: Voice-to-text AI note tool that rewrites and polishes what you say, used by 200k people, with multiple output styles and cross-device sync.

desc.zh: 专为 Apple 设备打造的语音优先笔记应用，在本机离线转写并把口述整理成摘要、待办与逐字稿，可一键发往 Notion、Obsidian 等。
desc.en: Voice-first note app for Apple devices that transcribes on-device while offline and turns speech into summaries, to-dos and full transcripts, with one-tap export to Notion or Obsidian.

desc.zh: Cubox 由苏州怪奇信息科技推出，是 AI 稍后阅读助手，把网页文章一键收藏、AI 自动摘要与全库问答，让收藏读得懂、记得住、用得上。
desc.en: AI read-it-later assistant: save web articles in one click, get automatic summaries and ask questions across your whole library, so saved material stays readable, memorable and useful.

desc.zh: 得到大脑是得到（罗辑思维）推出的 AI 记录与创作工具，主打语音说完自动成笔记，并用发芽、点评、拷问、润色把念头打磨成作品。
desc.en: Dedao's AI capture and creation tool: speak and it becomes a note, then sprouting, critiquing, questioning and polishing turn a passing thought into finished work.

desc.zh: Dinox 是本地优先的全平台 AI 笔记，支持闪念记录、富文本编辑、网页剪藏、自动标题标签、卡片盒双链与 AI 对话，并可自定义智能体与存储。
desc.en: Local-first AI note app across all platforms, with quick capture, rich text editing, web clipping, automatic titles and tags, Zettelkasten-style backlinks, AI chat, custom agents and choice of storage.

desc.zh: Fabric 是一个会思考的 AI 工作空间，官方称提供 50 多个集成与多名专属 AI 助手，把文件、笔记、创意与会议聚于一处，陪你写作、协作并发布。
desc.en: An AI workspace with 50+ integrations and several dedicated AI assistants, bringing files, notes, ideas and meetings together so you can write, collaborate and publish.

desc.zh: flomo 浮墨由上海仙蒂网络科技推出，是主打「像发微博一样记笔记」的极简卡片笔记工具，支持微信、App、网页多端速记、标签回顾与 API 联动工作流。
desc.en: A minimalist card-based note tool built around noting things as casually as posting to social media, with multi-device capture via WeChat, app and web, tag-based review and API workflows.

desc.zh: Granola 是面向密集会议的 AI 记事本，无需会议机器人、直接调用电脑音频记录，自动生成增强笔记与行动项，支持 Mac、Windows、iOS 与 Android。
desc.en: AI notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. No meeting bot — it captures calls from your computer's audio and produces enhanced notes and action items on Mac, Windows, iOS and Android.

desc.zh: 闪念贝壳是 ideaShell 出品的 AI 思维伙伴，覆盖手表、手机与电脑，支持语音文字待办随手记录并多设备同步，还能与 AI 一起把想法打磨成可执行的成果。
desc.en: AI thinking partner from ideaShell across watch, phone and desktop: capture voice, text and to-dos on the fly, sync across devices, and refine ideas into executable results together with AI.

desc.zh: 讯飞语记由科大讯飞出品，是一款语音变文字输入的云笔记，支持实时语音听写、会议录音转写、拍照识别、图文编排、笔记朗读与多端同步。
desc.en: iFlytek's voice-to-text cloud notebook, supporting live dictation, meeting transcription, photo recognition, rich text layout, note read-aloud and multi-device sync.

desc.zh: 隐私优先的 AI 会议记录工具，无需会议机器人即可生成多语言结构化笔记、逐字稿与待办事项，符合 GDPR 并可与 Notion 等同步。
desc.en: Privacy-first AI meeting note taker that needs no meeting bot, producing structured multilingual notes, transcripts and action items. GDPR compliant and syncs to Notion and others.

desc.zh: 以 AI Agent 为核心的笔记工作区，无负担记录笔记、会议、想法与研究并自动整理为持久记忆，Agent 理解任务目标、适时主动介入推进，适合多项目并行者。
desc.en: AI-agent-centred note workspace: capture notes, meetings, ideas and research without friction, then let it organise them into durable memory. The agent grasps task goals and steps in to push work forward.

desc.zh: 开源的个人知识管理应用，覆盖网页、Mac、iOS 与 Chrome 扩展，支持极速捕捉、网页剪藏、自动整理与图谱检索，并可离线使用。
desc.en: Open-source personal knowledge management app for web, Mac, iOS and Chrome, with instant capture, web clipping, automatic organisation, graph search and offline use.

desc.zh: 喵记多是由 mojidoc 团队推出的 AI 笔记，内置喵仔助理，支持语音速记、待办同步日历、图片识别与网页剪藏，主打边聊边记的第二大脑。
desc.en: AI note app from the mojidoc team with a built-in assistant: voice capture, to-dos synced to your calendar, image recognition and web clipping — a second brain you chat with while capturing.

desc.zh: 墨问是主打「记录即创作」的轻量笔记与发布工具，以网页和小程序为载体，让笔记可分享、可发布、可变现，让有价值的内容在人与人之间流动。
desc.en: Lightweight note-taking and publishing tool built on the idea that recording is creating, available on the web and as a mini program, so notes can be shared, published and monetised.

desc.zh: mymind 是一个私密的第二大脑，官方称用 AI 帮你记住笔记、图片、书签与摘抄而无需手动分类整理，所有内容存于一个私密空间，专注保护你的数据与心智。
desc.en: A private second brain: AI remembers your notes, images, bookmarks and clippings so you never have to sort them into folders, all kept in one private space.

desc.zh: NotebookLM 是 Google 的 AI 研究助手，上传 PDF、网页、视频等来源后基于原文作答并附引用，可生成音频概览、视频概览、思维导图、闪卡与测验，支持笔记本共享。
desc.en: Google's AI research assistant: upload PDFs, web pages or videos and get answers grounded in the source with citations, plus audio overviews, video overviews, mind maps, flashcards and quizzes.

desc.zh: 开源、可私有化部署的 AI 研究笔记工具，定位「私有地掌控研究」，提供 AI 笔记、播客生成与隐私控制，被视为 NotebookLM 的自托管替代品。
desc.en: Open-source, self-hostable AI research notebook positioned around owning your research privately, offering AI notes, podcast generation and privacy controls as a NotebookLM alternative.

desc.zh: 氢刻是一款卡片笔记与高效记忆工具，用卡片捕捉信息知识想法，通过 AI 测验与间隔复习（艾宾浩斯记忆法）实现信息到知识的高效转化。
desc.en: Card-based note-taking and memory tool that captures information, knowledge and ideas on cards, then converts them into lasting knowledge through AI quizzes and spaced repetition.

desc.zh: Recall 是个人 AI 知识库，官方称被 70 万专业人士使用，可总结文章、视频、播客、PDF 并自动互联，用 ChatGPT、Claude 或 Gemini 与收藏内容对话。
desc.en: Personal AI knowledge base used by 700k professionals: summarise articles, videos, podcasts and PDFs, let them interconnect automatically, and chat with your saved content using ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.

desc.zh: Reflect 是一款极致简洁、原生集成 AI 的笔记应用，支持极速同步、反向链接知识图谱、端到端加密与日历集成，AI 基于 GPT-4 与 Whisper。
desc.en: A strikingly minimal notes app with AI integrated natively: instant sync, a backlinked knowledge graph, end-to-end encryption and calendar integration, powered by GPT-4 and Whisper.

desc.zh: 面向 Google Meet、Zoom、Teams 的 AI 会议记录扩展，会议中实时转写并一键生成摘要与待办，支持 60 多种语言及 Slack 等自动化推送。
desc.en: AI meeting transcription extension for Google Meet, Zoom and Teams that transcribes live and generates summaries and action items in one click, across 60+ languages, with automation pushes to Slack.

desc.zh: Voicenotes 是一款在后台自动工作的 AI 会议记录工具，官方称符合 SOC 2 与 GDPR，支持所有会议应用且无机器人入会，把每场会议变成清晰纪要和可追问的答案。
desc.en: AI meeting recorder that works in the background: SOC 2 and GDPR compliant, compatible with every meeting app without a bot joining, turning each meeting into clear notes and answerable questions.

desc.zh: AI 学习与创作工作室，把文章、视频、播客等资料收藏一处，与 AI 提问串联形成自己的见解，再产出文章、幻灯片、图片、视频与网页，覆盖网页、桌面与移动端。
desc.en: AI learning and creation studio: collect articles, videos and podcasts in one place, question them with AI to form your own view, then produce articles, slides, images, video and web pages.

desc.zh: Agentset 是开源 RAG 与智能体构建平台，几分钟搭出生产级问答应用：多模态解析图片图表表格、自动引用来源、支持元数据过滤与自托管，基准测试表现领先。
desc.en: Open-source RAG and agent building platform that gets a production Q&A app running in minutes: multimodal parsing of images, charts and tables, automatic source citations, metadata filtering and self-hosting.

desc.zh: 基于你真实数据库表结构的 AI SQL 助手，用自然语言生成、解释、修复与优化查询，并支持通过 MCP 让 Claude、Cursor、ChatGPT 等客户端直连数据库。
desc.en: AI SQL assistant grounded in your real database schema: generate, explain, fix and optimise queries in natural language, and connect Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT to your database through MCP.

desc.zh: 在终端里运行的 AI 结对编程工具，自动映射代码库、支持 100 多种语言与多模型接入，并把每次改动直接提交进 Git，全程可追溯。
desc.en: AI pair programmer that runs in your terminal: maps the codebase automatically, supports 100+ languages and multiple model providers, and commits every change straight to Git for a full audit trail.

desc.zh: 硅心科技推出的企业级AI研发平台，以代码智能体、测试智能体、代码文档与需求智能体构建产品矩阵，支持私有化部署与大小模型协同，面向金融航天等企业研发场景。
desc.en: Enterprise AI development platform with a product matrix of code, testing, documentation and requirements agents, supporting private deployment and large-plus-small model collaboration for finance and aerospace.

desc.zh: AWS 面向企业场景的生成式 AI 助手，接入企业内部数据回答问题、生成内容，覆盖开发、商业智能、客服与供应链等岗位，并推进决策类任务。
desc.en: AWS's generative AI assistant for the enterprise: answer questions from internal data and generate content across development, business intelligence, customer service and supply chain roles, and take on decision-making tasks.

desc.zh: Base44 是无代码 AI 开发平台，用自然语言把想法变成可运行的应用与网站，内置后端、存储、数据库、支付与托管，无需写代码，适合创业者与团队快速搭建全栈产品。
desc.en: No-code AI development platform that turns natural language into running apps and websites, with backend, storage, database, payments and hosting included — no coding required.

desc.zh: Bolt.new 是用对话生成应用与网站的 AI 构建工具，自动选模型并即时预览，内置数据库、认证、托管与 SEO，号称可处理大项目并自动测试纠错，适合产品、创业与营销快速上线。
desc.en: Conversational builder for apps and websites with automatic model selection and instant preview, plus built-in database, auth, hosting and SEO, along with automatic testing and error correction.

desc.zh: Cleanlab 实时给 AI 回复打可信度分，识别幻觉、用错上下文与知识盲区，用单一指标决定何时拦截或转人工，守护问答与客服系统的输出质量。
desc.en: Scores AI responses for trustworthiness in real time, spotting hallucinations, misused context and knowledge gaps, and uses a single metric to decide when to block or escalate to a human.

desc.zh: 华为云推出的企业级代码智能体，主打Agent团队协作、规范驱动开发与大规模代码库理解，支持鸿蒙专属模型与命令行终端接入，面向团队研发全流程与安全合规场景。
desc.en: Huawei Cloud's enterprise code agent, built around agent team collaboration, specification-driven development and large-codebase understanding, with HarmonyOS-specific models and command-line access.

desc.zh: 腾讯云推出的 AI 全流程智能编程工具，官方称提供 IDE、编辑器插件与 CLI 三种形态，基于混元等对话大模型，覆盖需求分析、设计稿转代码、代码补全与一键部署。
desc.en: Tencent Cloud's end-to-end AI coding tool in three forms — IDE, editor plugin and CLI — built on Hunyuan and other conversational models, covering requirements analysis, design-to-code, completion and one-click deployment.

desc.zh: 蚂蚁集团开源的代码大模型工具链，覆盖多任务微调框架、静态代码分析、测试智能体、语义缓存与评测基准，面向研发全生命周期，供企业与开发者自主部署使用。
desc.en: Ant Group's open-source code model toolchain spanning multi-task fine-tuning, static analysis, testing agents, semantic caching and evaluation benchmarks across the development lifecycle.

desc.zh: 智谱AI推出的智能编程助手，提供代码生成与补全、注释生成、代码翻译与智能问答，适配VS Code与JetBrains系列等主流IDE，模型权重已开源，面向个人与企业私有化场景。
desc.en: Zhipu AI's coding assistant offering generation and completion, comment generation, code translation and Q&A, adapted to VS Code and JetBrains IDEs, with open model weights for individuals and private enterprise use.

desc.zh: 极狐GitLab推出的AI编程与DevOps研发助手，把智能能力融入代码托管、CI/CD与安全审计等工作流，支持SaaS与私有化部署，面向企业研发效能与数据安全场景。
desc.en: JiHu GitLab's AI coding and DevOps assistant, weaving intelligence into code hosting, CI/CD and security auditing, with SaaS and private deployment options for enterprise efficiency and data security.

desc.zh: 文心快码 Comate 是百度基于文心大模型的编程工具，支持代码补全、单测、注释与智能问答，提供多智能体调度与多文件编辑，可接入 VS Code、JetBrains 等 IDE。
desc.en: Baidu's coding tool built on the ERNIE model, supporting completion, unit tests, comments and Q&A, with multi-agent orchestration and multi-file editing, plugging into VS Code and JetBrains IDEs.

desc.zh: 开源 AI 代码助手项目，主打接入任意模型自定义补全与对话；团队已被 Cursor 收购，开源代码库仍可自由获取，可自行部署与改造。
desc.en: Open-source AI code assistant project focused on connecting any model with custom completion and chat. The team was acquired by Cursor; the open-source code remains freely available to deploy and modify.

desc.zh: AI 原生编程智能体，把任务交给它自主规划、并行推进多步改动，支持多模型选择与跨仓库工程，贯通桌面端与 CLI 双界面。
desc.en: AI-native coding agent that plans tasks autonomously and works through multi-step changes in parallel, with model choice, cross-repository engineering and both desktop and CLI interfaces.

desc.zh: Devin 是 Cognition 推出的自主 AI 软件工程师，并行云端处理跨仓库工程任务：PR 审查与视觉 QA、代码迁移重构、Issue 分诊、文档生成，还能学会你的代码库。
desc.en: Cognition's autonomous AI software engineer, working cloud-side on cross-repository tasks in parallel: PR review and visual QA, migrations and refactors, issue triage, documentation — and it learns your codebase.

desc.zh: Emergent 是 YC S24 的 AI 应用构建平台，用自然语言对话让多个 AI 代理完成设计、编码、测试与部署，生成可拥有的全栈 Web/移动应用，适合快速从想法到上线。
desc.en: A YC S24 AI app building platform where multiple AI agents handle design, coding, testing and deployment through natural conversation, producing full-stack web and mobile apps that you own.

desc.zh: 面向开发者的开源模型微调与部署平台，支持数据集管理、效果评估与无服务器推理，强调数据主权与模型权重归属；注意其官网近期无法访问，服务状态需先确认。
desc.en: Open-source model fine-tuning and deployment platform for developers, with dataset management, evaluation and serverless inference, emphasising data sovereignty and model ownership. Note: the site has been unreachable recently — verify service status first.

desc.zh: GitHub 官方 AI 编程助手：从 issue 到审查并合并 PR 全程参与，覆盖编辑器、终端、桌面端与 GitHub 网页；。
desc.en: GitHub's official AI coding assistant, involved from issue through review to merged PR across your editor, terminal, desktop and the GitHub website.

desc.zh: 把任意 Git 仓库变成适合喂给大模型的纯文本摘要，替换网址关键词即可生成，支持过滤规则、体积限制与私有仓库，开源可自部署。
desc.en: Turns any Git repository into a plain-text digest ready to feed to a large model — just swap a URL keyword. Supports filtering rules, size limits and private repos, and is open source and self-hostable.

desc.zh: deepset 维护的开源 AI 编排框架，用模块化组件搭建可上生产的智能体、检索增强与语义搜索系统，每一步都可检视、调试与替换。
desc.en: Open-source AI orchestration framework from deepset for building production agents, retrieval-augmented generation and semantic search from modular components you can inspect, debug and swap out.

desc.zh: Helicone 是开源 LLM 可观测与 AI 网关平台：请求日志、监控告警、策略路由、多维细分与 HQL 分析，改一行 base_url 接入，被增长最快的 AI 公司使用。
desc.en: Open-source LLM observability platform and AI gateway: request logs, monitoring and alerts, policy routing, breakdowns and HQL analytics — adopt it by changing one base_url.

desc.zh: 开源 AI 编码代理，覆盖 VS Code、JetBrains、CLI 与云端，可接入 500 多个模型并支持自带密钥零加价，用本地模型可保护代码隐私。
desc.en: Open-source AI coding agent spanning VS Code, JetBrains, CLI and the cloud, with access to 500+ models, bring-your-own-key at no markup, and local models for code privacy.

desc.zh: LangChain 现在的自我定位是「拥有你自己智能的开放 Agent 平台」。它的主张是让每家公司掌控自己的智能：用开放的 Agent 工程平台去控制、治理并积累智能资产，官方称已被 7000+ 组织使用。
desc.en: An open agent engineering platform built on the argument that every company should own its intelligence — control it, govern it and compound it as an asset. Used by 7000+ organisations.

desc.zh: 开源（MIT）的 LLM 工程平台，把追踪、评估、提示词管理与数据集整合一处，基于 OpenTelemetry，用生产数据持续改进 AI 应用，可自托管。
desc.en: Open-source (MIT) LLM engineering platform bringing tracing, evaluation, prompt management and datasets together on OpenTelemetry, so production data keeps improving your AI app. Self-hostable.

desc.zh: 以文档智能为核心的 AI 数据框架，旗舰能力 LlamaParse 用智能体式 OCR 把带复杂表格、图表的文档解析成 AI 可用的结构化上下文。
desc.en: AI data framework centred on document intelligence. Its flagship LlamaParse uses agentic OCR to turn documents with complex tables and charts into structured context that models can use.

desc.zh: LLM 是知名开源开发者 Simon Willison 出品的命令行工具兼 Python 库，让大模型的使用回归终端：直接在命令行里对 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini、Qwen、Gemma、Kimi、DeepSeek…
desc.en: Command-line tool and Python library from Simon Willison that brings large models back to the terminal, letting you prompt OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Gemma, Kimi, DeepSeek and more from the shell.

desc.zh: 面向大语言模型交互的查询编程语言，用类型、模板与约束描述输出，配优化运行时，让提示词更稳健、更可复用，跨本地与云端后端。
desc.en: A query language for interacting with large language models: describe output with types, templates and constraints, backed by an optimising runtime for more robust, reusable prompts across local and cloud backends.

desc.zh: 用自然语言把想法变成可部署的全栈应用的低代码 AI 平台，覆盖对话式生成、托管、支付接入与安全，无需深厚编码基础即可从原型到上线。
desc.en: Low-code AI platform that turns natural language into deployable full-stack apps, covering conversational generation, hosting, payments and security — from prototype to launch without deep coding.

desc.zh: 开源的 LLM 路由器与网关，用一个 OpenAI 兼容端点接入订阅制、按量计费、本地模型与自定义供应商，自动修复错误请求并在故障时切换备用模型。
desc.en: Open-source LLM router and gateway: reach subscription, pay-per-token, local and custom providers through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with automatic request repair and failover to backup models.

desc.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的文档与知识平台，文档可自我更新、以结构化方式被智能体读取，已有两万多家公司用于开发者知识库与知识管理，让文档持续保持最新。
desc.en: Documentation and knowledge platform built for AI agents: docs that update themselves and are read structurally by agents, used by 20,000+ companies to keep developer knowledge current.

desc.zh: MLflow 是最大的开源 AI 工程平台，覆盖 Agent、LLM 与传统模型：链路观测、系统评估、提示词优化、AI 网关与模型部署一站搞定，让 AI 迭代快十倍。
desc.en: The largest open-source AI engineering platform, spanning agents, LLMs and traditional models: tracing, evaluation, prompt optimisation, an AI gateway and model deployment in one place.

desc.zh: MCP 是由 Anthropic 推动的开源标准，让 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 应用以统一方式连接数据源、工具与工作流，一套接口打通外部世界，生态支持日趋广泛。
desc.en: MCP is the open standard championed by Anthropic that lets AI apps such as Claude and ChatGPT connect to data sources, tools and workflows in a uniform way — one interface to the outside world, with a growing ecosystem.

desc.zh: OpenAI 面向代码场景的能力与开发文档入口，开发者可从这里创建 API Key、安装 SDK 跑通首次调用，并了解智能体构建与多模态模型选型。
desc.en: OpenAI's entry point for coding work and developer documentation: create API keys, install SDKs and make a first call, and learn about building agents and choosing multimodal models.

desc.zh: OpenCode 是开源 AI 编程代理，可在终端、IDE 与桌面端写代码，支持 LSP、多会话并行与 75+ 模型，隐私优先不存储代码。
desc.en: Open-source AI coding agent that works in the terminal, IDE and desktop, supporting LSP, parallel sessions and 75+ models, and storing no code for privacy.

desc.zh: Phoenix 是 Arize 开源的 Agent 开发与评估平台：可视化每一步调用、用实验证明改动有效，一条命令本地启动，可自托管，让 Agent 质量提升有据可依。
desc.en: Arize's open-source agent development and evaluation platform: visualise every call, prove changes work through experiments, and run it locally with one command or self-host it.

desc.zh: 面向生成式 AI 的生产级平台，以 AI 网关统一接入多家模型，配套可观测性、护栏、治理与提示词管理，现已更名为 PRISMA AIRS AI Gateway。
desc.en: Production platform for generative AI that unifies model providers behind an AI gateway with observability, guardrails, governance and prompt management. Now renamed PRISMA AIRS AI Gateway.

desc.zh: 阿里云推出的 AI 编程智能体（原「通义灵码」，2026 年 5 月正式更名），官方称提供代码智能生成、研发智能问答、多文件修改与编程智能体等能力，支持多种国产大模型自由切换。
desc.en: Alibaba Cloud's AI coding agent (formerly Tongyi Lingma, renamed in May 2026), offering code generation, development Q&A, multi-file edits and agent workflows, with free switching between several domestic models.

desc.zh: 面向代码审查的 AI 平台，提供跨仓库上下文与 15 种以上智能体工作流，覆盖 IDE、PR 与安全场景，把团队规范变成可执行的治理规则。
desc.en: AI platform for code review with cross-repository context and 15+ agent workflows spanning the IDE, pull requests and security, turning team standards into enforceable governance rules.

desc.zh: 商汤推出的AI代码助手，支持单行与整段补全、注释生成代码、多轮对话以及单元测试和部署脚本生成，兼容VS Code与JetBrains系列等IDE，提供免费版与私有化部署。
desc.en: SenseTime's AI coding assistant with line and block completion, comment-to-code, multi-turn chat, and generation of unit tests and deployment scripts. Compatible with VS Code and JetBrains IDEs; free tier and private deployment.

desc.zh: Replit 是云端 IDE 与 AI 应用构建平台，浏览器里用 Replit Agent 对话式生成并部署全栈应用，内置认证、数据库、托管与集成，适合从原型到上线。
desc.en: Cloud IDE and AI app building platform: use Replit Agent in the browser to generate and deploy full-stack apps conversationally, with auth, database, hosting and integrations built in.

desc.zh: 把整个代码库打包成 AI 友好格式的开源工具，支持本地与远程仓库，可输出 XML、Markdown、JSON 或纯文本，内置 token 计数、压缩与安全过滤。
desc.en: Open-source tool that packs an entire codebase into an AI-friendly format — local or remote repos, output as XML, Markdown, JSON or plain text, with token counting, compression and security filtering.

desc.zh: 自动为代码生成文档的工具，提供 VS Code 扩展与 API，保存即自动更新整库说明，并为问题附上 Stack Overflow 与官方文档参考。
desc.en: Automatic code documentation tool with a VS Code extension and an API: save and the whole repository's explanations update, with answers referencing Stack Overflow and official documentation.

desc.zh: 主打代码隐私与合规的企业级 AI 代码助手，提供补全与智能体能力，通过企业上下文引擎在自有环境中可控部署，已被 Tricentis 收购。
desc.en: Enterprise AI code assistant built around code privacy and compliance, with completion and agent capabilities deployed under your control through an enterprise context engine. Acquired by Tricentis.

desc.zh: 字节跳动 TRAE 旗下的 AI 编程 IDE，官方称提供 IDE 与 SOLO 双重开发模式，内置可接管任务并调度工具的 Coding Agent，支持自定义智能体与 MCP。
desc.en: ByteDance's AI coding IDE under TRAE, offering both IDE and SOLO development modes with a coding agent that takes over tasks and orchestrates tools, plus custom agents and MCP support.

desc.zh: 开源的本地 AI 工作台，桌面端即可下载模型对话，无代码微调模型，还能本地生成与编辑图像视频，并可把编码智能体接到自己的 GPU。
desc.en: Open-source local AI workbench: download and chat with models on the desktop, fine-tune without writing code, generate and edit images and video locally, and attach coding agents to your own GPU.

desc.zh: Vercel 出品的 AI 构建平台，用提示词直出可上生产的全栈 Web 应用，支持设计模式微调、仓库同步与一键部署，还能在手机端创作与发布。
desc.en: Vercel's AI building platform that turns prompts into production-ready full-stack web apps, with design-mode refinement, repo sync and one-click deployment — including authoring and publishing from your phone.

desc.zh: 开源 SQL 智能体框架，让不懂 SQL 的用户用自然语言查询公司各业务系统，内置用户级权限、配额管理、现成 UI 组件，支持多数据库与多轮对话。
desc.en: Open-source SQL agent framework that lets non-SQL users query business systems in natural language, with per-user permissions, quota management and ready-made UI components across multiple databases.

desc.zh: 原 Windsurf AI 编辑器，现已并入 Cognition 的 Devin 体系，官网指向 Devin Desktop，可在统一界面调度本地与云端的多个编码智能体。
desc.en: The former Windsurf AI editor, now folded into Cognition's Devin family and pointing to Devin Desktop, where multiple coding agents run locally and in the cloud from a single interface.

desc.zh: 开源核心的生成式 BI 智能体，用语义层（MDL）把自然语言转成 SQL，商业版与开源版跑同一上下文引擎，支持云端、VPC 与气隙部署。
desc.en: Open-core generative BI agent that translates natural language into SQL through a semantic layer (MDL). Commercial and open-source editions share one context engine, deployable to cloud, VPC or air-gapped environments.

desc.zh: Zed 是 Atom 与 Tree-sitter 作者打造的高性能多人代码编辑器，用 Rust 编写、支持 AI 代理并行编辑与内联助手，可团队实时协作，适合追求速度与协作开发者。
desc.en: High-performance multiplayer code editor from the authors of Atom and Tree-sitter, written in Rust with parallel AI agent edits and an inline assistant, built for developers who care about speed and collaboration.

desc.zh: 虹软推出的视觉AI算法开放平台，以免费人脸识别SDK为核心，提供人脸检测、比对、查找、活体检测与大面积遮挡识别等能力，支持终端与服务器部署，面向门禁考勤场景。
desc.en: ArcSoft's vision AI platform, centred on a free face recognition SDK with detection, comparison, search, liveness detection and heavy-occlusion recognition, deployable on device or server for access control and attendance.

desc.zh: 百度智能云的图像识别 API 服务，支持 10 万种物体与场景识别，开放动物、植物、花卉、菜品、Logo、车辆定损等专项能力。
