desc.en: Baidu AI Cloud's image recognition API, recognising 100,000 object and scene types with dedicated models for animals, plants, flowers, dishes, logos and vehicle damage assessment.

desc.zh: 使用深度卷积神经网络（CNN）做图片无损放大的工具，官方称最高可放大 16 倍并智能降噪，针对插画与照片分别优化，重建线条与细节而非拉伸像素，另提供客户端、API 与老照片修复。
desc.en: AI image upscaling with deep convolutional neural networks: up to 16x with smart denoising, separately tuned for illustrations and photos, rebuilding lines and detail rather than stretching pixels. Desktop app, API and old photo restoration.

desc.zh: AI 图像编辑工具集，几秒钟完成抠图、去物体、放大、扩图、替换背景与文字擦除，支持各平台尺寸适配，并提供 API 供开发者快速集成进产品。
desc.en: AI image editing toolkit that cuts out, removes objects, upscales, outpaints, swaps backgrounds and erases text in seconds, with platform-ready sizes and an API for developers.

desc.zh: AI 图像编辑与视频生成平台，提供去背景、人像抠图、消除物体、画质增强、上色与图生视频，聚合 Nano Banana Pro、Seedream 等模型，并提供独立 API。
desc.en: AI image editing and video generation platform with background removal, portrait cutout, object eraser, upscaling, colorisation and image-to-video, aggregating models such as Nano Banana Pro and Seedream with a standalone API.

desc.zh: Deep-Image.ai 是偏电商与印刷的 AI 图像增强平台，官网称支持生成式超分、最高 4 倍放大、单次最多 50 张批量处理，并提供 API 与 Zapier 集成。
desc.en: AI image enhancement platform leaning toward e-commerce and print, supporting generative super-resolution, up to 4x enlargement and batches of 50 images at a time, with an API and Zapier integration.

desc.zh: 旷视推出的计算机视觉开放平台，提供人脸检测比对搜索、活体检测、人像处理、文字识别与图像识别等API和SDK，支持公有云调用与离线部署，面向金融营销教育等行业。
desc.en: Megvii's computer vision platform offering APIs and SDKs for face detection, comparison and search, liveness detection, portrait processing, OCR and image recognition, available on public cloud or offline.

desc.zh: Hive 是提供内容理解 API 的 AI 平台，官网列出视觉、文本与音频审核、AI 生成图像与视频识别、OCR 与商标名人识别等模型，按调用量计费。
desc.en: Hive provides content understanding APIs, with models for visual, text and audio moderation, AI-generated image and video detection, OCR, and trademark or celebrity recognition, billed by usage.

desc.zh: 浏览器里的在线图片编辑与转换工具集，提供压缩、改尺寸、裁剪、去背景、AI 修图、AI 上色与 AI 放大等 28 个应用，支持 JPG、PNG、WEBP、PDF 等格式互转。
desc.en: Online image editing and conversion toolkit in the browser: 28 apps covering compression, resizing, cropping, background removal, AI retouching, colourisation and upscaling, converting between JPG, PNG, WEBP and PDF.

desc.zh: ImgLarger 是在线 AI 图片放大与增强工具站，官网称可放大至 8 倍并提供超分，另有扩图、锐化、去背景与老照片修复，注册每月送 100 积分。
desc.en: Online AI upscaling and enhancement site offering up to 8x enlargement with super-resolution, plus outpainting, sharpening, background removal and old photo restoration. 100 credits a month on signup.

desc.zh: 数美科技的内容安全与业务风控平台，提供文本、图片、音频、视频等多模态内容检测，并覆盖注册登录保护、营销风控与大模型安全围栏，面向直播社交电商与出海业务。
desc.en: Content safety and risk control platform covering text, image, audio and video moderation, plus registration and login protection, marketing risk control and LLM guardrails for live streaming, social, e-commerce and overseas businesses.

desc.zh: Landing AI 现主推企业文档处理平台，官方称 ADE 可把任意文档转成可审计的结构化数据，结果带页码坐标引用与置信度，支持云端或私有化部署。
desc.en: Enterprise document processing platform: its ADE turns any document into auditable structured data with page-level coordinate citations and confidence scores, deployable to cloud or on-premise.

desc.zh: 在线 AI 画质增强与放大工具，提供补正、放大与修复三类处理，官方称最高放大 16 倍、支持 512MP 与 300DPI 输出，另有 API 与电商方案 Claid.ai。
desc.en: Online AI upscaling and enhancement tool with correction, enlargement and restoration modes, output up to 16x, 512MP and 300DPI, plus an API and an e-commerce offering called Claid.ai.

desc.zh: Mathpix 是面向科研的文档转换平台，官网称可把 PDF 和图片转成 LaTeX、Word、Excel 与 ChemDraw，覆盖公式、手写与表格，提供 OCR API。
desc.en: Research document conversion platform that turns PDFs and images into LaTeX, Word, Excel and ChemDraw, covering formulas, handwriting and tables, with an OCR API.

desc.zh: Pebblely 是面向电商的 AI 商品图生成工具，官网称无需 Photoshop 即可把一张商品图变成多种营销素材，提供 100+ 模板与批量生成。
desc.en: E-commerce AI product image generator that turns one product photo into a range of marketing assets without Photoshop, with 100+ templates and batch generation.

desc.zh: 面向创作者、品牌与商家的在线 AI 视觉工具，官网称 7000 万人在用。提供图像与视频去背景、最高 16 倍放大、扩图、生成式修图与阴影，支持批量编辑、品牌素材一致性与 API。
desc.en: Online AI visual tools for creators, brands and merchants, used by 70M people: background removal for images and video, up to 16x upscaling, outpainting, generative retouching and shadows, with batch editing and an API.

desc.zh: 面向开发者与企业的计算机视觉平台，覆盖数据管理、标注、训练到云端与边缘部署，官方称超 100 万工程师在用，配套 Inference、supervision 等开源库。
desc.en: Computer vision platform for developers and enterprises covering data management, labelling, training and cloud or edge deployment, used by 1M+ engineers, with open-source libraries including Inference and supervision.

desc.zh: 面向平台方的内容审核与图像分析 API，覆盖图片、视频、文本与音频审核，可识别 AI 生成内容与深伪、做重复检测与头像校验，官方称提供每月 2000 次操作的免费额度。
desc.en: Content moderation and image analysis API for platforms, covering image, video, text and audio moderation, AI-generated content and deepfake detection, duplicate detection and avatar verification. 2000 free operations a month.

desc.zh: 合合信息旗下的智能文档处理平台，可把PDF、Office与扫描件解析为结构化数据，提供表格公式识别、单据审核流转以及图像增强、去水印等能力，面向企业文档自动化。
desc.en: Intelligent document processing platform from Intsig that parses PDFs, Office files and scans into structured data, with table and formula recognition, document review workflows, image enhancement and watermark removal.

desc.zh: 图普科技的人工智能应用平台，提供图片、视频、音频与文本的内容审核能力，并延伸出客流统计、货架审计等零售视觉方案以及人脸识别、安全帽识别等安防通行能力。
desc.en: AI application platform offering image, video, audio and text moderation, extending into retail vision such as footfall counting and shelf auditing, plus face recognition and safety helmet detection for security and access.

desc.zh: Ultralytics 是 YOLO 系列视觉模型的开源团队，官方称可一站完成标注、训练与部署，支持 YOLOv5 到 YOLO26，覆盖检测、分割与姿态，闭源商用需企业许可。
desc.en: The open-source team behind the YOLO vision model series, covering labelling, training and deployment for YOLOv5 through YOLO26 across detection, segmentation and pose estimation. Closed-source commercial use requires an enterprise licence.

desc.zh: 在线 AI 图片放大与增强工具，官方称可放大至 2 倍或 4 倍而不丢失纹理细节，注册即送前 3 个积分。另提供锐化、去模糊、去雾霾、人脸修复、老照片上色，以及批量转换与 API。
desc.en: Online AI image upscaling and enhancement tool that enlarges 2x or 4x without losing texture detail, with the first three credits free. Also sharpening, deblurring, dehazing, face restoration, old photo colourisation, batch conversion and an API.

desc.zh: VanceAI 提供网页端与 Windows 桌面端的 AI 图像视频处理工具集，官方列出放大、锐化、降噪、去背景与老照片修复等模型，支持批量与本地离线处理。
desc.en: AI image and video processing toolkit for web and Windows desktop, with models for upscaling, sharpening, denoising, background removal and old photo restoration, supporting batches and offline local processing.

desc.zh: 面向社媒电商的 AI 视频工作台，一张商品图即可生成 TikTok、Reels 风格的 UGC 视频，集成水印去除、视频增强、AI 数字人与翻译配音，官方称提供免费额度。
desc.en: AI video workbench for social commerce: turn one product photo into TikTok or Reels-style UGC video, with watermark removal, video enhancement, AI avatars and translation dubbing. Free tier available.

desc.zh: AlphaSense 是面向金融与企业决策的 AI 市场情报平台，官方称收录 5 亿多份研报、公司文件与专家访谈文档，用生成式 AI 做检索与合成，支持接入企业内部资料。
desc.en: AI market intelligence platform for financial and corporate decision-making, with 500M+ research reports, filings and expert interview documents that generative AI can search and synthesise, alongside your internal content.

desc.zh: 创业邦旗下的创新及科技企业投资价值数据分析平台，覆盖上市与创投支持企业、投资并购与基金数据，并推出可对话查询的睿兽 AI 智能体。
desc.en: Innovation and tech-company investment analysis platform from Cyzone, covering listed and venture-backed companies, investment and M&A data, funds, plus a conversational Bestla AI agent.

desc.zh: 面向创投与商业研究的市场情报平台，提供公司与交易数据、行业研究，并已接入 AI Agent 与 MCP，支持外部系统集成。
desc.en: Market intelligence platform for venture and business research, offering company and deal data and industry studies, with AI agents and MCP available for integrating into external systems.

desc.zh: 蝉妈妈是电商洞察平台，为品牌、商家、达人与 MCN 提供抖音数据分析，覆盖找达人、找商品、找直播，并有蝉管家做直播运营管理。
desc.en: E-commerce insight platform giving brands, merchants, creators and MCNs Douyin analytics — finding creators, products and live streams — plus a companion tool for live-stream operations management.

desc.zh: 现为 HubSpot Breeze Assistant 的免费商务 AI 助手，基于账号真实数据作答，嵌入营销、销售、服务等模块提供个性化指导，对 HubSpot 用户不额外收费。
desc.en: Now the free business AI assistant inside HubSpot Breeze: it answers from your account's real data and gives tailored guidance inside marketing, sales and service modules, at no extra cost for HubSpot users.

desc.zh: 私营公司数据与预测情报平台，官网主打融资、增长、收购、IPO 等预测模型与实时信号，提供公司、投资人检索与 Scout 自然语言查询。
desc.en: Private company data and predictive intelligence platform built around forecasting models and real-time signals for funding, growth, acquisitions and IPOs, with company and investor search and natural-language Scout queries.

desc.zh: 数说故事是原生 AI 科技公司，自研 SocialGPT 与 EnlightAI 多智能体系统，把市场信息转化为洞察与增长方案，覆盖洞察、营销与销售。
desc.en: An AI-native company whose in-house SocialGPT and EnlightAI multi-agent systems turn market information into insight and growth plans across insight, marketing and sales.

desc.zh: Exploding Topics 是趋势发现平台，官方称可提前 12 个月以上发现新兴趋势、初创公司与产品，提供关键词研究、竞品分析等免费工具，付费版解锁趋势数据库与预测能力。
desc.en: Trend discovery platform that claims to spot emerging trends, startups and products 12+ months early, with free keyword research and competitor analysis tools and a paid trend database with forecasting.

desc.zh: 飞瓜数据提供短视频与直播电商数据分析，覆盖抖音、快手与 B 站，包含选品、达人筛选、广告投放、营销舆情与达人分销管理工具，面向品牌与达人团队。
desc.en: Short-video and live-commerce data analytics covering Douyin, Kuaishou and Bilibili, with product selection, creator screening, ad placement, sentiment monitoring and creator distribution management.

desc.zh: 清博智能是人工智能与大数据科技企业，业务覆盖大模型与智能体、智库报告、指数榜单、数字人与视频营销，服务品牌、政务与媒体传播场景。
desc.en: An AI and big-data company whose business spans large models and agents, think-tank reports, index rankings, digital humans and video marketing for brands, government and media.

desc.zh: 灰豚数据是短视频与直播电商数据分析平台，提供达人资源、爆款选品与内容趋势洞察，并有灰豚精选与热度云服务达人分销场景，覆盖主流内容平台。
desc.en: Short-video and live-commerce analytics platform offering creator resources, breakout product selection and content trend insight, plus curated lists and creator distribution services across major content platforms.

desc.zh: 头豹研究院是全行业原创研究平台，以 AI 与人工结合的方式产出行业研报、词条与产业链图谱，并提供行业规模预测模型，覆盖科技与消费等领域。
desc.en: Full-industry original research platform combining AI with human analysts to produce industry reports, encyclopedia entries and supply chain maps, plus market-size forecasting models across tech and consumer sectors.

desc.zh: 久谦中台是兼具商业尽调与中台研究能力的研究服务机构，通过顾问团队、样本库与数据资源，为投资机构与企业客户提供快速结构化的商业信息。
desc.en: Research firm combining commercial due diligence with platform research, using a consultant team, sample panels and data resources to deliver fast, structured business information to investors and corporates.

desc.zh: 魔镜洞察是在线零售市场的 AI 分析师，基于电商与社媒数据做市场研究、竞品分析、消费者洞察与产品创新，并提供出海市场洞察，适合品牌方与电商运营团队。
desc.en: AI analyst for online retail markets, using e-commerce and social data for market research, competitor analysis, consumer insight and product innovation, plus overseas market insight for brands and e-commerce teams.

desc.zh: 新榜是内容产业服务平台，提供新媒体数据、榜单与矩阵管理，并推出矩阵通、声量通与 GEO 数智，用于社媒监测与 AI 搜索优化，官方称覆盖新媒体内容与品牌营销场景。
desc.en: Content industry service platform offering new-media data, rankings and matrix management, with social monitoring and AI-search optimisation products for new-media content and brand marketing.

desc.zh: 企查查面向 AI 智能体的企业数据平台，通过 MCP 接入主流 AI 工具，提供企业工商、风险、知产与经营数据工具，用于尽调与商业情报。
desc.en: Enterprise data platform built for AI agents: connect through MCP to mainstream AI tools and query company registration, risk, IP and operating data for due diligence and business intelligence.

desc.zh: 千瓜数据定位种草营销数据服务专家，围绕小红书提供市场研究、品类洞察、品牌解析、达人管理、笔记创作与投放全链路管理，并推出 AI 营销数据产品。
desc.en: Data service specialist for seeded marketing on Xiaohongshu, covering market research, category insight, brand analysis, creator management, note creation and full-funnel campaign management, plus AI marketing data products.

desc.zh: 数字数据与市场情报平台，官网称覆盖网站与应用流量、竞品对比、AI 搜索可见度、广告与电商等维度，并提供 Web、App、AI Search 等情报产品与 API 数据服务。
desc.en: Digital data and market intelligence platform covering website and app traffic, competitor benchmarking, AI search visibility, advertising and e-commerce, with web, app and AI search intelligence products and API data services.

desc.zh: 新浪舆情通是政企舆情监测平台，提供全网舆情监测、分钟级预警、多类事件分析与舆情报告，并拥有新浪微博官方数据授权，服务政务与品牌客户。
desc.en: Government and enterprise public opinion monitoring platform with network-wide monitoring, minute-level alerts, multi-type event analysis and reports, using official Weibo data authorisation.

desc.zh: 知微数据是人工智能大数据情报服务商，提供舆情与声誉风险管理、竞争情报与市场洞察、宏观政策研究与海外舆情风险监测，服务头部品牌与机构。
desc.en: AI big-data intelligence provider covering public opinion and reputation risk management, competitive intelligence and market insight, macro policy research and overseas sentiment risk monitoring.

desc.zh: 面向 B2B 营收团队的 GTM 情报平台，官方称服务 3.5 万+ 企业，提供企业与联系人数据、购买意向信号、网站访客识别、Copilot AI 代理及 CRM 数据治理。
desc.en: GTM intelligence platform for B2B revenue teams, used by 35k+ companies, with company and contact data, buying intent signals, website visitor identification, Copilot AI agents and CRM data governance.

desc.zh: 国内规模较大的 AI 知识库与工具导航社区，按文本、图像、视频、音频、效率等类别整理上千个工具，覆盖智能体、提示词、活动与硬件，内容由飞书知识库承载。
desc.en: One of China's largest AI knowledge bases and tool directories, organising well over a thousand tools by text, image, video, audio and productivity, and covering agents, prompts, events and hardware.

desc.zh: 百度飞桨旗下面向 AI 学习者的学习与实训社区，集成免费课程、云端 GPU 算力、经典数据集与样例项目，支持文心一言大模型开发、一键部署与算法竞赛。
desc.en: Baidu PaddlePaddle's learning and practice community for AI students, combining free courses, cloud GPU compute, classic datasets and sample projects with ERNIE model development, one-click deployment and algorithm competitions.

desc.zh: 彩云小译是支持中英日等多语互译的 AI 翻译工具，提供文字、文档、网页双语对照与同声传译，并配套浏览器插件、移动端与翻译 API。
desc.en: Caiyun's AI translation tool supporting Chinese, English, Japanese and more, with text, document and bilingual web translation plus simultaneous interpretation, and a browser extension, mobile app and translation API.

desc.zh: Connected Papers 是帮助研究者可视化探索学术文献的工具，输入一篇论文即可生成相关论文关系图谱，用于选题调研、查漏与构建参考文献。
desc.en: Helps researchers explore academic literature visually: enter one paper and it builds a graph of related work, useful for surveying a topic, spotting gaps and assembling references.

desc.zh: 主打翻译准确度的 AI 翻译工具，支持文本、文档与语音翻译，提供术语表、语气与风格配置，官方称全球超 20 万家企业信赖，每天数百万人使用。
desc.en: AI translation tool built around accuracy, supporting text, document and voice translation with glossaries and tone or style controls. Trusted by 200,000+ businesses and used by millions every day.

desc.zh: 吴恩达创办的 AI 在线课程平台，超 700 万学员，从机器学习基础到生成式 AI、提示词工程与 Agentic AI 开发，提供专项课、短课、认证与会员体系。
desc.en: Andrew Ng's AI course platform with 7M+ learners, spanning machine learning fundamentals to generative AI, prompt engineering and agentic AI development through specialisations, short courses, certificates and membership.

desc.zh: 字节跳动推出的AI学习应用，提供拍题答疑、作文辅导等学习支持，采用订阅方式解锁更多使用次数，覆盖日常作业练习、写作批改与知识点讲解等场景。
desc.en: ByteDance's AI learning app, offering photo-based problem solving and essay coaching. A subscription unlocks more usage, covering homework practice, writing feedback and concept explanations.

desc.zh: 上传论文后划词即可获得通俗解释，可围绕整篇论文提问并自动生成要点洞察，官方称已有 40 万以上研究者使用，帮读者更快读懂艰涩文献。
desc.en: Upload a paper and highlight any phrase for a plain-language explanation, ask questions about the whole paper and get automatic key insights. Used by 400k+ researchers.

desc.zh: Glasp 是面向研究者与学习者的网页与 PDF 高亮标注工具，可免费标注任意网页与文档、用 AI 总结 YouTube 视频，并把标注沉淀为可对话的个人知识库。
desc.en: Web and PDF highlighting tool for researchers and learners: annotate any page or document for free, summarise YouTube videos with AI, and build the highlights into a chat-ready personal knowledge base.

desc.zh: 沉浸式翻译是国内开发者打造的双语对照 AI 翻译工具，内置 ChatGPT、DeepL、Gemini 等 20 余个翻译引擎，覆盖网页、PDF、视频字幕、图片与漫画的双向对照翻译。
desc.en: Bilingual AI translation tool with 20+ engines including ChatGPT, DeepL and Gemini, covering two-column translation of web pages, PDFs, video subtitles, images and comics.

desc.zh: Khanmigo 是可汗学院（非营利）打造的 AI 教学助手与家教，面向教师备课、学生批判性思维训练与家长作业辅导，覆盖数学、写作等多学科。
desc.en: Khan Academy's AI teaching assistant and tutor, supporting teachers with lesson prep, students with critical-thinking practice and parents with homework help across maths, writing and more.

desc.zh: LanguageTool 是支持 30 多种语言的语法与拼写检查工具，可校对语法、标点、大小写与风格，提供 AI 改写，并有浏览器扩展、邮件与办公插件、桌面应用和校对 API。
desc.en: Grammar and spelling checker for 30+ languages covering grammar, punctuation, capitalisation and style, with AI rewriting, plus browser extensions, email and office plugins, a desktop app and a proofreading API.

desc.zh: 提示词工程学习平台，60+ 模块课程已翻译成 9 种语言，提供免费课程、认证体系与企业培训方案，官方称 300 万+ 人学习。
desc.en: Prompt engineering learning platform with 60+ modules translated into nine languages, offering free courses, a certification track and enterprise training. 3M+ learners.

desc.zh: 面向科研人员的英文文献阅读器，提供学科化的翻译与解析能力，帮助快速读懂论文内容，官方称其信息安全与隐私管理通过国际标准认证，适合研究生与科研工作者。
desc.en: English literature reader for researchers, with discipline-specific translation and parsing to get through papers quickly. Its information security and privacy management are certified to international standards.

desc.zh: 英语流利说推出的AI英语学习产品，以人工智能老师提供口语练习与评测，结合自适应方式安排学习内容，面向希望练习口语与提升听说能力的成人学习者。
desc.en: Liulishuo's AI English learning product, using an AI teacher for speaking practice and assessment with adaptive lesson sequencing, aimed at adults who want to improve spoken and listening skills.

desc.zh: Reverso 是主打语境例句的翻译与写作助手，官方称支持 25 种以上语言的文本与文档翻译，内置词典、同义词、动词变位与母语者发音，并提供 AI 拼写与语法检查。
desc.en: Translation and writing assistant built around example sentences in context: text and document translation in 25+ languages, plus a dictionary, synonyms, verb conjugations, native-speaker pronunciation and AI spelling and grammar checking.

desc.zh: Scholarcy 是面向学术论文的 AI 摘要与文献管理工具，可把论文、文章、教材与视频转成结构化摘要卡片，并支持引用整理与导出到笔记应用。
desc.en: AI summarisation and literature tool for academic papers: turn papers, articles, textbooks and videos into structured summary cards, with reference management and export to note apps.

desc.zh: SciSpace 是 PubGenius 出品的 AI 学术研究助手，官方称可在 2.8 亿篇以上论文中做系统性文献综述并带引用写论文，覆盖文献检索、PDF 阅读与综述写作等场景。
desc.en: AI research assistant that runs systematic literature reviews across 280M+ papers and writes with citations, covering literature search, PDF reading and review writing.

desc.zh: Semantic Scholar 是艾伦人工智能研究院（Ai2）的学术检索工具，官网显示可检索 2 亿多篇论文，提供 TLDR 摘要、高影响力引用与文献库，并有论文问答与 API。
desc.en: AI2's academic search tool covering 200M+ papers, with TLDR summaries, influential citation signals and research libraries, plus paper Q&A and an API.

desc.zh: 学而思推出的AI答疑产品，基于九章大模型提供引导式解题讲解，强调通过提问帮助理解思路而非直接给答案，面向中小学数学等学科的学习与练习场景。
desc.en: Xueersi's AI Q&A product, built on the Jiuzhang model to deliver guided problem solving — asking questions that build understanding rather than handing over answers. Aimed at school maths and related subjects.

desc.zh: Speak 是主打英语口语练习的 AI 对话学习应用，无需真人老师即可与 AI 导师随时对话练口说，提供个性化课程与语法修正，官方称全球数百万用户在用。
desc.en: AI conversation app focused on spoken English: practise with an AI tutor any time instead of a human teacher, with personalised lessons and grammar correction. Millions of users worldwide.

desc.zh: 松鼠AI的智适应个性化学习系统，通过知识图谱与学习数据定位薄弱点，提供虚拟老师互动、错题本、遗忘复习与跨学段追根溯源等功能，面向中小学个性化学习场景。
desc.en: Squirrel AI's adaptive personalised learning system, using a knowledge graph and learning data to locate weak points, with a virtual teacher, mistake notebook, forgetting-curve review and cross-grade root-cause tracing.

desc.zh: 网易有道推出的AI全科学习助手，基于自研子曰大模型，提供多学科答疑与解题讲解，官方说明生成内容仅供参考，面向中小学生日常作业与知识查漏补缺场景。
desc.en: NetEase Youdao's AI learning assistant for all subjects, built on its in-house Ziyue model, offering multi-subject Q&A and worked solutions. Generated content is explicitly informational only.

desc.zh: 洋葱学园推出的AI智能学伴，基于自研教育大模型与动画课程内容，提供拍照解题、一对一答疑、学习规划与思维引导等能力，面向小学到高中的多学科自主学习场景。
desc.en: Yangcong Academy's AI study companion, built on an in-house education model and animated course content, offering photo-based problem solving, one-to-one Q&A, study planning and thinking guidance from primary through high school.

desc.zh: 面向科研阅读的文献翻译工具，自带PDF阅读器并支持划词翻译，汇集多家翻译引擎与大模型，提供跨页翻译、智能分段、锁定翻译等功能，官方称服务器不缓存隐私内容。
desc.en: Literature translation tool for research reading, with a built-in PDF reader and select-to-translate across multiple engines and large models, plus cross-page translation, smart segmentation and pinned translations. Server-side content is not cached.

desc.zh: 成立于2015年的在线教育平台，围绕学习工具与智能硬件布局，提供拍照搜题、答疑辅导、全学科作业辅导与口算批改等能力，并自研教育大模型，面向学生与家长场景。
desc.en: Online education platform founded in 2015, spanning study tools and smart hardware: photo-based problem search, tutoring, all-subject homework help and mental arithmetic marking, built on its own education model.

desc.zh: 人民网国重实验室、中国科大与合肥综合性国家科学中心人工智能研究院联合推出的 AI 生成内容检测工具，支持文本与图像检测并给出置信度。
desc.en: AI-generated content detection tool from People's Daily's State Key Laboratory, USTC and the Hefei Comprehensive National Science Center AI Institute, supporting text and image detection with confidence scores.

desc.zh: 覆盖图像、文本、音乐、语音与视频的 AI 检测服务，可区分 AI 生成与深度伪造，官网称准确率 98.9%，提供免费沙盒、API 与按量计费，支持本地化部署。
desc.en: AI detection across images, text, music, speech and video, distinguishing AI-generated content from deepfakes with a claimed 98.9% accuracy. Free sandbox, API and usage-based pricing, with on-premise deployment.

desc.zh: 主打 AI 文本人性化的改写工具，官网称为 AI Humanizer，可一键改写并自查 AI 检测与重复度，支持多语言与 API，提供免费额度试用。
desc.en: AI text humaniser that rewrites content in one click and self-checks AI detection and similarity, with multilingual support and an API. Free tier to try — note the compliance boundaries of rewriting tools.

desc.zh: 知网面向个人用户的查重与 AIGC 检测服务，官方称采用自适应多阶语义指纹检测技术，从语言模式与语义逻辑两条链路判别文本的 AI 生成特征。
desc.en: CNKI's plagiarism and AIGC detection service for individuals, using adaptive multi-order semantic fingerprinting to judge AI-generated characteristics through both language patterns and semantic logic.

desc.zh: 面向企业与教育机构的文本真实性平台，提供 AI 检测、查重、代码抄袭与 AI 视频检测，官方称支持 30 多种语言、误报率 0.03%，可通过 API 与多种 LMS 集成。
desc.en: Text authenticity platform for enterprises and educators, offering AI detection, plagiarism checking, code plagiarism and AI video detection in 30+ languages with a claimed 0.03% false positive rate, integrable via API and LMS.

desc.zh: 老牌网页抄袭检测服务，在公开网页中检索内容是否被复制，官网称已被出版、SEO、教育等领域使用二十多年，Premium 提供批量搜索、API 与自动监控。
desc.en: Long-established web plagiarism detection service that searches public pages for copied content, used across publishing, SEO and education for over twenty years. Premium adds batch search, an API and automatic monitoring.

desc.zh: 超星旗下的文献检测系统，提供相似度检测、AIGC 检测、格式检测、一键排版与 AI 智评，官方称依托图书资源实现书刊并重检测。
desc.en: Chaoxing's literature detection system offering similarity checking, AIGC detection, format checking, one-click typesetting and AI review, drawing on its book resources to check books and journals alike.

desc.zh: 专注深度伪造视频检测的在线扫描工具，可粘贴视频链接或上传文件判断视频是否被合成篡改，官方标注仍处于 beta，结果仅供参考，另提供企业级本地化部署方案。
desc.en: Online deepfake video detection scanner: paste a link or upload a file to judge whether a video has been synthesised or manipulated. Still labelled beta with results for reference only; enterprise on-premise deployment available.

desc.zh: 面向学术内容检测的工作台，一站式提供论文查重、格式检测、格式校正与 AIGC 检测，支持上传后跟踪状态并统一管理检测记录，服务高校师生论文写作与自查场景。
desc.en: Academic content checking workbench offering plagiarism checking, format checking, format correction and AIGC detection in one place, with status tracking and unified records for students and staff.

desc.zh: GPTZero 把自己定位为「为保护人类写作而生」的 AI 检测器，官方称其为全球第一的 AI 内容检测工具，用户超过 1700 万。
desc.en: An AI detector positioning itself around protecting human writing, described as the world's leading AI content detection tool with 17M+ users.

desc.zh: 以 AI Agent 工作台为主打的创作平台，一句话即可完成研究、幻灯片、文档、图像与视频；站内提供 HIX Bypass 文本改写入口，并支持多模型切换与定时任务。
desc.en: Creation platform built around an AI agent workbench: complete research, slide decks, documents, images and video from one sentence, with a text-rewriting entry point, multi-model switching and scheduled tasks.

desc.zh: 同时支持图像与文本的 AI 检测服务，官方称可给出生成概率并标出被生成的图像区域与可疑段落，覆盖篡改图与 Deepfake，免费档位长期使用。
desc.en: AI detection for both images and text that reports generation probability and highlights generated image regions and suspicious passages, covering manipulated images and deepfakes. Free tier available long term.

desc.zh: 上海合合信息科技股份有限公司，官方定位多模态大模型文本智能技术领先者，旗下有扫描全能王、TextIn、启信宝，并推出多模态可信 AI 鉴伪系统。
desc.en: Shanghai Intsig Information positions itself as a leader in multimodal large-model text intelligence, behind CamScanner, TextIn and Qixinbao, with a multimodal trusted AI authenticity system.

desc.zh: 主打多语言的 AI 内容检测工具，官方称支持 80 多种语言、覆盖中文场景，提供句子级与短语级分析、抄袭检测与语法检查，附带批量扫描与报告生成。
desc.en: Multilingual AI content detection tool supporting 80+ languages including strong Chinese coverage, with sentence-level and phrase-level analysis, plagiarism checking, grammar checking, batch scanning and reporting.

desc.zh: 把 AI 人性化改写、AI 检测与多模型聊天放在同一账号，官方称检测免费不限次数，写作工具支持 36 种语言，另有 Chrome 扩展与 Google Docs 插件。
desc.en: Puts AI text humanising, AI detection and multi-model chat under one account, with unlimited free detection, writing tools in 36 languages, plus a Chrome extension and a Google Docs add-on.

desc.zh: 面向内容团队与教育场景的 AI 检测工具，一次扫描可同时查 AI 概率、查重、语法与事实核查；支持 Chrome 扩展、Moodle 与 API，并用写作回放佐证作者身份。
desc.en: AI detection tool for content teams and education that checks AI probability, plagiarism, grammar and facts in a single scan, with a Chrome extension, Moodle integration and an API, using writing replay to support authorship claims.

desc.zh: 面向中文学术写作的查重与 AIGC 检测平台（运营主体智齿数汇），提供免费查重、智能降重、降 AIGC、格式检测与自建库，报告支持逐句标注与来源溯源。
desc.en: Plagiarism and AIGC detection platform for Chinese academic writing, offering free checks, smart rewriting, AIGC reduction, format checking and a custom comparison library, with sentence-level annotation and source tracing.

desc.zh: 武汉亿次源旗下论文查重平台，提供论文查重与 AIGC 查重降重、智能降重、班级组队查重与自建库比对，并附带 PDF 转换、翻译与润色工具。
desc.en: Plagiarism checking platform offering paper and AIGC checks, smart rewriting, class team checks and custom library comparison, with bundled PDF conversion, translation and polishing tools.

desc.zh: 定位安全可控的人工智能基础设施提供商，旗下 DeepReal 做生成式内容检测，另有 AI 安全平台、人脸安全防火墙与隐私计算产品，面向政府与金融场景。
desc.en: Positions itself as a provider of safe, controllable AI infrastructure: DeepReal handles generative content detection, alongside AI security, face security firewall and privacy computing products for government and finance.

desc.zh: 面向 AI 鉴伪场景的产品，官方称基于多模态伪造检测技术提供检测、取证、溯源全流程方案，覆盖公共安全、金融安全与教育媒体安全。
desc.en: AI authenticity verification product offering detection, forensics and traceability based on multimodal forgery detection, covering public safety, financial security and education or media security.

desc.zh: 面向开发者与企业的语言模型工具平台，提供语法检查、AI 检测、自动补全、改写与情感分析，官方称比其他检查器多抓出 60% 的语言质量问题，可通过 API 与 SDK 接入。
desc.en: Language model tooling platform for developers and enterprises, offering grammar checking, AI detection, autocomplete, rewriting and sentiment analysis. Claims to catch 60% more language quality issues than other checkers, via API and SDK.

desc.zh: 面向学生的学术写作平台，提供免费 AI 检测器、查重、引用生成与人工校对润色；AI 检测单次上限 1,200 词，支持英西德法四种语言，能区分 AI 生成与 AI 润色。
desc.en: Academic writing platform for students with a free AI detector, plagiarism checking, citation generation and human proofreading. AI detection handles up to 1,200 words per check in English, Spanish, German and French, distinguishing AI generation from AI polishing.

desc.zh: 主打 AI 文本内容人性化的改写工具，官方称在模型层面处理困惑度与突发性并内置检测器验证，支持中文界面，网站自述服务超百万用户。
desc.en: AI text humaniser that addresses perplexity and burstiness at the model level and verifies results with a built-in detector. Chinese interface available; the site claims over a million users.

desc.zh: 面向教育机构的学术诚信平台，官方称与全球 16,000 多家机构合作；AI 写作检测作为 Similarity Report 的附加功能提供，仅教师与管理员可见。
desc.en: Academic integrity platform for educational institutions, working with 16,000+ organisations worldwide. AI writing detection is an add-on to the Similarity Report, visible only to instructors and administrators.

desc.zh: 把 AI 检测与文本人性化放在同一平台，另有 AI 图片、PDF 与音频检测、Chrome 扩展和 API；官方称支持 50 多种语言、按字数分档订阅，改写类功能需注意合规边界。
desc.en: Combines AI detection and text humanising on one platform, plus AI image, PDF and audio detection, a Chrome extension and an API. 50+ languages and word-count-based tiers; note the compliance boundaries for rewriting.

desc.zh: 维普论文检测系统提供的查重、格式、AIGC 与智评检测服务，按大学生、研究生、编辑部、职称等版本区分口径，支持个人版与机构统一管理。
desc.en: Plagiarism, format, AIGC and AI review detection services from the VIP paper checking system, with editions for undergraduates, postgraduates, editorial offices and professional titles, available individually or managed institution-wide.

desc.zh: 万方数据推出的学术质量察验平台，一次送检可同时完成文本相似、文本 AIGC、图像复用、参考文献风险与用语规范等多要素检测。
desc.en: Academic quality inspection platform from Wanfang Data that checks text similarity, text AIGC, image reuse, reference risk and language standards in a single submission.

desc.zh: 面向教育、出版与 SEO 团队的 AI 内容检测工具，官方称准确率 99.98%；支持 OCR 识别扫描件、逐句预测图、查重与 AI 图像检测，可生成可分享的真实性报告。
desc.en: AI content detection tool for education, publishing and SEO teams with a claimed 99.98% accuracy. Supports OCR for scans, sentence-level prediction graphs, plagiarism checking and AI image detection, with shareable authenticity reports.

desc.zh: 把 AI 文本人性化与 AI 检测放在一起的工具，提供 Standard 与 Enhanced 两种模式，内置句级 AI 概率检测，并支持 Chrome 扩展与移动端应用。
desc.en: Pairs AI text humanising with AI detection in Standard and Enhanced modes, with built-in sentence-level AI probability checking, plus a Chrome extension and mobile app.

desc.zh: 网易智企旗下的数字内容风控平台，提供文本、图片、音频、视频检测与 AI 人脸鉴伪，覆盖 AIGC 全生命周期风控、业务安全与应用安全。
desc.en: NetEase's digital content risk control platform, offering text, image, audio and video detection and AI face forgery detection, covering the full AIGC lifecycle alongside business and application security.

desc.zh: 免费 AI 内容检测工具，逐句高亮并给出 AI 占比，支持批量文件、多语言与报告导出，另有图片/视频检测及改写等配套工具。
desc.en: Free AI content detector that highlights text sentence by sentence with an AI percentage, supporting batch files, multiple languages and report export, plus companion image and video detection and rewriting tools.

desc.zh: 腾讯推出的免费 AI 生成内容检测工具，基于多种先进模型与数百万级数据训练，中文检测表现尤为出色，支持文本与图像检测，并提供 API 便于接入审核流程。
desc.en: Tencent's free AI-generated content detector, trained on multiple advanced models and millions of samples, notably strong on Chinese, supporting text and image detection with an API for moderation pipelines.

desc.zh: 为 arXiv 论文提供讨论区的开放平台，每篇论文都可评论、提问与批注，同时按主题聚合热门论文，帮助快速跟进 AI 领域前沿动态。
desc.en: Open platform adding a discussion layer to arXiv papers: comment, question and annotate every paper while browsing trending work by topic — a fast way to keep up with AI research.

desc.zh: 众包模式的 AI 模型竞技场，两个模型匿名对战由用户投票分胜负，并据此生成 LLM、图像与代码模型的公开排行榜，内置落地页、仪表盘、小游戏等任务模板可直接实测。
desc.en: Crowdsourced AI model arena where two anonymous models compete and users vote, producing public leaderboards for LLM, image and code models, with landing page, dashboard and mini-game templates to test directly.

desc.zh: 独立评测 AI 模型与 API 服务商的基准站，围绕智能指数、输出速度与单任务成本横向对比，覆盖编码、语音、图像、视频等多门类榜单与搜索服务商对比。
desc.en: Independent benchmark site for AI models and API providers, comparing intelligence index, output speed and cost per task across coding, speech, image and video leaderboards, plus provider comparisons.

desc.zh: 荷兰乌得勒支大学协调开发的开源文献筛选工具，用主动学习边筛边学、按相关度排序，把系统综述的筛稿时间大幅压缩，完全开源且符合 GDPR。
desc.en: Open-source literature screening tool coordinated by Utrecht University that uses active learning to rank papers by relevance as you screen, sharply cutting systematic review screening time. Fully open source and GDPR compliant.

desc.zh: 面向同行评审文献的 AI 学术搜索引擎，用自然语言提问即可在 2.5 亿篇论文中检索证据，并直观呈现研究结论的一致与分歧，支持 Deep Search 自动化综述与医学模式。
desc.en: AI academic search engine for peer-reviewed literature: ask in natural language and find evidence across 250M papers, with a clear view of where findings agree and disagree, plus automated reviews via Deep Search and a medical mode.

desc.zh: 开源且隐私优先的 AI 数据分析工具，连接你的数据库后在本地完成查询与可视化，数据不离开设备，支持自然语言提问与逐步迭代探索。
desc.en: Open-source, privacy-first AI data analysis tool: connect your database and query and visualise locally so data never leaves your machine, supporting natural-language questions and iterative exploration.

desc.zh: AI 科研助手，输入研究问题即可在 1.25 亿篇以上论文中检索，自动生成带引用的结构化研究报告，并支持数据抽取、系统性文献综述与文库提醒。
desc.en: AI research assistant: enter a research question and search 125M+ papers, then get structured, cited research reports, with data extraction, systematic literature reviews and library alerts.

desc.zh: Exa 是一个面向 AI 应用设计的搜索 API，官方定位是「为需要实时网页数据的 AI Agent 提供搜索、深度研究与结构化内容，全部通过一个端点完成」。
desc.en: A search API designed for AI applications, positioned as giving AI agents search, deep research and structured web content through a single endpoint.

desc.zh: 帆软旗下企业级自助 BI 平台，7.0 以指标为中心统一管理口径与血缘，提供自助看板、AI 问答与归因预警，官网称已服务 43000+ 客户。
desc.en: FanRuan's enterprise self-service BI platform: version 7.0 manages metrics, definitions and lineage centrally, with self-service dashboards, AI Q&A and root-cause alerts. 43,000+ customers.

desc.zh: 面向研究与写作的 AI 工具，用自研算法自动摘要文献、分析研究并定位关键信息，帮助更快产出博客、文章与报告，提供 14 天免费试用。
desc.en: AI tool for research and writing that uses in-house algorithms to summarise literature, analyse studies and surface key information, speeding up blogs, articles and reports. 14-day free trial.

desc.zh: 观远数据的一站式智能分析平台，提供数据采集、分析与可视化展现能力，官方称两天培训后业务人员可自主完成多数分析工作，面向消费品零售银行等行业的经营分析场景。
desc.en: One-stop intelligent analytics platform covering data collection, analysis and visualisation. After two days of training, business users can handle most analysis themselves, aimed at consumer, retail and banking operations.

desc.zh: 衡石科技的新一代AI增强Agentic BI平台，提供数据集成、指标建模、可视化分析与ChatBI能力，并开放命令行工具供编码智能体执行BI工程，面向软件厂商与集团IT团队。
desc.en: AI-enhanced agentic BI platform offering data integration, metric modelling, visual analysis and ChatBI, plus a command-line tool for coding agents to run BI engineering tasks. Built for software vendors and group IT teams.

desc.zh: 面向数据团队的分析协作平台，将 SQL、Python 与 AI 工作流合一，可用提示词生成交互式数据应用，强调受信任的团队自助取数与 AI 回答可管控。
desc.en: Analytics collaboration platform for data teams that unifies SQL, Python and AI workflows, generating interactive data apps from prompts, with trusted self-service access and governable AI answers.

desc.zh: 全球领先的开源 AI 社区，托管 200 万+ 模型、数据集与 Spaces 应用，提供推理服务、云端算力与团队企业版，支撑模型选型、试用、微调与部署全流程。
desc.en: The leading open AI community, hosting 2M+ models, datasets and Spaces apps, with inference services, cloud compute and team and enterprise tiers across model selection, trial, fine-tuning and deployment.

desc.zh: 腾讯推出的AI知识管家，支持搭建个人与团队知识库，对导入资料做问答与检索，并可根据资料生成PPT、播客与研究报告，面向资料整理与内容创作场景。
desc.en: Tencent's AI knowledge manager: build personal and team knowledge bases, ask questions and search across imported material, and generate slide decks, podcasts and research reports from it.

desc.zh: 面向知识工作者的 AI 工作台，用自然语言连接数据库、分析数据并生成报告、演示、图表与多模态内容，支持 Postgres、Snowflake 等数据源，已获 SOC 2 认证。
desc.en: AI workbench for knowledge workers that connects to databases in natural language, analyses data and produces reports, presentations, charts and multimodal content. Supports Postgres, Snowflake and more; SOC 2 certified.

desc.zh: Google 旗下数据科学与 AI 社区平台，集成公开数据集、云端 Notebook、算法竞赛、预训练模型与免费课程，提供免费 GPU/TPU，覆盖从入门到前沿基准的全流程。
desc.en: Google's data science and AI community platform, combining public datasets, cloud notebooks, competitions, pretrained models and free courses, with free GPU and TPU access from beginner tutorials to frontier benchmarks.

desc.zh: AI 搜索引擎，提问后检索网页并给出带来源的答案，提供网页、找人、深度研究三种模式，其中 Firsthand 专用于找到能回答 AI 答不了之事的真人，搜索结果可回溯历史。
desc.en: AI search engine that retrieves the web and returns answers with sources, with web, people-finding and deep research modes. Firsthand mode locates real humans who can answer what AI cannot, and searches are traceable.

desc.zh: Kyligence的AI指标平台，通过低代码方式定义与管理业务指标，提供AI Copilot对话式洞察与Excel指标探索，并支持把分析能力嵌入自有应用，面向数据驱动决策场景。
desc.en: AI metrics platform that defines and manages business metrics with low code, offering conversational insight through an AI Copilot and metric exploration in Excel, and embedding analytics into your own applications.

desc.zh: 把 300 多个 AI 模型的智能水平、速度与价格折算成单一综合分的独立榜单，数据持续从公开基准与真实 API 指标更新，支持多任务维度排行。
desc.en: Independent leaderboard folding 300+ AI models' intelligence, speed and price into a single composite score, continuously updated from public benchmarks and real API metrics, with rankings across task dimensions.

desc.zh: 无广告的中文 AI 搜索引擎，直接输出带来源的答案，支持全网、学术、文库范围切换，并提供深度研究、上传文件问答与语音输入。
desc.en: Ad-free Chinese AI search engine that returns answers with sources directly, switching between web, academic and document scopes, with deep research, file-based Q&A and voice input.

desc.zh: 阿里达摩院发起的开源模型社区，汇集最新模型、数据集与创空间，覆盖视觉、NLP、语音、多模态与科学计算，提供推理、微调、在线算力与 AIGC 专区。
desc.en: Open-source model community from Alibaba DAMO Academy gathering the latest models, datasets and Spaces across vision, NLP, speech, multimodal and scientific computing, with inference, fine-tuning, online compute and an AIGC section.

desc.zh: 按真实调用量排名的 LLM 使用榜单，基于开发者通过 OpenRouter API 处理的 token 数统计，提供任务、成本与市场份额等多维排名，反映生产环境的真实选择。
desc.en: LLM usage leaderboard ranked by real request volume, based on tokens processed by developers through the OpenRouter API, with rankings by task, cost and market share — reflecting what production actually chooses.

desc.zh: AI 答案搜索引擎，用自然语言提问即可得到带引用来源的结论，支持追问、多种检索模式与上传文档问答，适合需要边查边核对的检索场景。
desc.en: AI answer engine: ask in natural language and get conclusions with cited sources, with follow-ups, multiple retrieval modes and document-based Q&A for search where you need to verify as you go.

desc.zh: 曾面向开发者提供带引用的技术问答搜索，并自研代码模型。官方服务已于 2026 年 1 月 16 日关停，官网 404，数据已清除，仅适合了解历史与迁移选型。
desc.en: Once a developer-focused technical search engine with citations, backed by its own code models. The service shut down on 16 January 2026, the site returns 404 and data was deleted — of historical interest only.

desc.zh: 微软推出的商业智能平台，连接并统一企业数据，用可信语义模型与 Copilot 自然语言洞察赋能全员自助 BI，并可嵌入 Microsoft 365 工作流。
desc.en: Microsoft's business intelligence platform: connect and unify enterprise data, then give everyone self-service BI through trusted semantic models and Copilot natural-language insight, embeddable in Microsoft 365 workflows.

desc.zh: 阿里巴巴全资子公司瓴羊的数据分析产品，提供拖拽式自助分析与大模型驱动的智能问数能力，官方称连续多年入选Gartner分析平台魔力象限，面向企业经营分析场景。
desc.en: Data analytics product from Lingyang, an Alibaba subsidiary: drag-and-drop self-service analysis plus large-model-driven natural-language querying, repeatedly named in Gartner's analytics platform Magic Quadrant.

desc.zh: AI 驱动的系统性文献综述平台，官方称百万研究者用于筛选、去重与 PICO 提取，支持多人协作与审计追踪，还有移动端与偏倚风险评估，基础版永久免费。
desc.en: AI systematic review platform used by a million researchers for screening, deduplication and PICO extraction, with collaboration, audit trails, mobile access and bias risk assessment. Free tier forever.

desc.zh: 专注文献综述的 AI 工具，以一篇种子论文生成引用图谱并持续推荐相关文献、新作者与新兴方向，官网显示已接入超 3.1 亿篇论文，注册免费。
desc.en: Literature review AI tool that builds a citation graph from one seed paper and keeps recommending related work, new authors and emerging directions. 310M+ papers indexed, free to sign up.

desc.zh: 查询本地模型硬件需求的检索工具，索引 506 个文本、代码、图像、视频、音频与 3D 模型，可按显存与内存反查能跑什么，也可按模型反查所需配置与性能基准。
desc.en: Hardware requirement lookup for local models, indexing 506 text, code, image, video, audio and 3D models: search by VRAM and RAM to see what runs, or by model to see the configuration and benchmarks it needs.

desc.zh: 面向学术研究的 AI 工具，以智能引用标明论文被支持或反驳，检索覆盖 3 亿篇以上文章、预印本与专利，可接入 Claude、ChatGPT 与 Zotero，给出可验证证据。
desc.en: Academic research tool whose Smart Citations show whether a paper was supported or contradicted, searching 300M+ articles, preprints and patents and integrating with Claude, ChatGPT and Zotero.

desc.zh: Scale AI 旗下 Labs 出品的专家驱动评测榜单，覆盖智能体编程、前沿推理与安全对齐等 20 多个基准、100 多个模型，可按能力维度分档浏览并持续更新。
desc.en: Expert-driven leaderboard from Scale AI Labs covering 20+ benchmarks and 100+ models across agentic coding, frontier reasoning and safety alignment, browsable by capability tier and continuously updated.

desc.zh: 数势科技的企业级数据智能体产品，以指标语义本体与AI Agent为核心，提供自然语言问数、归因洞察、报告生成与AI团队协作等能力，面向消费零售金融等行业决策场景。
desc.en: Enterprise data agent built around a metric semantic ontology and AI agents, offering natural-language querying, root-cause insight, report generation and AI team collaboration for decision-making in consumer, retail and finance.

desc.zh: Salesforce 旗下的商业智能与数据分析平台，可连接几乎所有数据库并拖拽生成可视化，已把 Agentic AI 与对话式分析（Tableau Agent）融入全线产品。
desc.en: Salesforce's business intelligence and analytics platform: connect to almost any database and drag to build visualisations, with agentic AI and conversational analysis (Tableau Agent) woven through the product line.

desc.zh: 永洪科技的企业级AI数据智能平台，提供BI分析、智能问数、数据建模、指标管理与数据治理等产品矩阵，官方称连续多届位居中国BI商业智能领域首位，面向企业数据分析场景。
desc.en: Enterprise AI data intelligence platform with a product matrix spanning BI analysis, natural-language querying, data modelling, metric management and data governance. Repeatedly ranked first in Chinese BI.

desc.zh: 知乎直答是知乎推出的 AI 大模型搜索产品，基于知海图大模型整合知乎社区与多源信息，无广告直达答案并支持深入/简略模式与多轮追问，适合专业与科普类检索。
desc.en: Zhihu's AI search product built on the Zhihai model, combining the Zhihu community with multi-source information: ad-free direct answers, deep or brief modes and multi-turn follow-ups, strong for professional and general-knowledge research.

desc.zh: 面向中小企业的 AI 营销平台，官方称把社媒内容、付费广告、落地页、口碑管理与 AI 销售开发整合为一套流程，内容按品牌语气生成并自动排期，官方称每月 79 美元起。
desc.en: AI marketing platform for small and medium businesses that folds social content, paid ads, landing pages, reputation management and AI sales development into one process, generating on-brand content and scheduling it automatically. From $79 a month.

desc.zh: Castmagic 是 AI 音频内容平台，把播客与录音一次转化成转录、摘要、社媒帖、博客与短视频等上百种可复用内容资产。
desc.en: AI audio content platform that turns a podcast or recording into transcripts, summaries, social posts, blog articles, short videos and hundreds of other reusable content assets in one pass.

desc.zh: 蝉大师旗下的 AI 数字人内容创作平台，官方称上传视频最快一分钟即可定制数字分身，支持脚本、PPT、产品资料与知识库一键成片，并提供爆款跟创、AI 声音设计与矩阵克隆。
desc.en: AI digital human content platform: customise a digital twin from an uploaded video in as little as a minute, turn scripts, decks, product material or a knowledge base into finished video, and clone voices with matrix accounts.

desc.zh: Choppity 是 AI 视频编辑器，把播客与长视频自动裁成 30 多条带字幕、带自动构图的短视频，并支持一键发布到各社媒平台。
desc.en: AI video editor that automatically cuts podcasts and long videos into 30+ captioned short clips with automatic framing, ready to publish to social platforms in one click.

desc.zh: 面向市场进入（GTM）团队的 AI 原生平台，把销售外呼、内容创作与线索处理编排成可复用工作流，打通 2000+ 工具且不绑定单一模型。
desc.en: AI-native platform for go-to-market teams that orchestrates sales outreach, content creation and lead handling into reusable workflows, connecting 2000+ tools without locking you to a single model.

desc.zh: Creatify 是面向社媒投放的 AI 广告生成平台，把商品链接一键转成多条可测试的视频/图片广告，并支持直接推送到社媒广告账户。
desc.en: AI ad generation platform for social campaigns: turn a product link into multiple testable video and image ads, and push them straight to your social ad accounts.

desc.zh: 百度官方出品的一站式 AIGC 创作平台，官方称支持 AI 成片、AI 生文、AI 故事、AI 剧本、动漫视频、高光剪辑、数字人与声音克隆，并可一键发布到百家号等内容生态。
desc.en: Baidu's all-in-one AIGC creation platform covering AI video assembly, AI writing, AI stories, AI scripts, anime video, highlight cutting, digital humans and voice cloning, with one-click publishing to Baidu's content ecosystem.

desc.zh: FeedHive 是带 AI 智能体的社媒自动化工具，学习你的品牌语气后一键生成内容，用工作流与排期把多个平台的内容运营自动化。
desc.en: Social media automation with AI agents: it learns your brand voice, generates content in one click, and automates multi-platform publishing through workflows and scheduling.

desc.zh: 巨量引擎推出的一站式智能创意生产与管理平台，官方称面向广告主提供短视频图文、数字人口播与直播等创意素材的 AI 生成与批量管理能力，需使用巨量引擎账号登录使用。
desc.en: Ocean Engine's one-stop creative production and management platform, giving advertisers AI generation and batch management of short-video, image-text, digital human presenter and live-stream creative. Requires an Ocean Engine account.

desc.zh: 企业级 AI 员工平台，官方称把微信客服、公众号、抖音、飞书、WhatsApp 等 IM 通道收进同一工作台，由 Agent 按置信度分档应答，并提供问数与多智能体编排能力。
desc.en: Enterprise AI employee platform that brings WeChat customer service, official accounts, Douyin, Feishu and WhatsApp into one workspace, where agents answer by confidence tier, with data Q&A and multi-agent orchestration.

desc.zh: 美图旗下的 AI 口播视频制作工具，官方称提供智能提词器、网感字幕、智能混剪、爆款复刻、画质修复与 AI 消除等能力，让用户用手机就能完成带网感的口播成片。
desc.en: Meitu's AI talking-head video tool, offering a smart teleprompter, native-feeling captions, smart montage, viral-format replication, quality restoration and AI object removal — shoot a polished piece to camera on your phone.

desc.zh: AI 短视频切片工具，官方称粘贴链接或上传长视频即可自动挑选高光片段并重构为竖屏短视频，自动加字幕与跟踪构图，可排期发布到 TikTok 与 YouTube。
desc.en: AI short-form clipper: paste a link or upload a long video to have highlights picked and rebuilt into vertical clips with captions and tracking framing, then scheduled to TikTok and YouTube.

desc.zh: Kleo 是面向 LinkedIn 的 AI 个人品牌工具，覆盖策略诊断、灵感发现、内容创作与发布分析，帮顾问、教练与创始人系统地经营个人 IP。
desc.en: AI personal branding tool for LinkedIn covering strategy diagnostics, inspiration discovery, content creation and publishing analytics, helping consultants, coaches and founders build a personal brand systematically.

desc.zh: 面向创作者与企业的 AI 动画与 3D 内容创作平台，官方称覆盖短剧漫剧、广告营销、创意社媒、MG 动画、数字人与 3D 创作六大场景，可从一句设定生成连续成片与可复用角色。
desc.en: AI animation and 3D content platform covering short-form drama, advertising, creative social content, motion graphics, digital humans and 3D creation, generating continuous footage and reusable characters from a single premise.

desc.zh: Lately 是用 AI 把长内容改写成社媒文案的工具，声称用神经科学技术学习品牌语气，把文章、播客、视频拆成能互动的高效社媒帖。
desc.en: Uses AI to turn long-form content into social copy, learning brand voice with neuroscience techniques and breaking articles, podcasts and videos into social posts that get engagement.

desc.zh: 面向中小企业的 AI 社媒营销工具，官方称导入官网、照片、视频甚至会议录音后，AI 会自动学习业务并生成内容策略与整月帖子，用户一键审批发布，并实时监测各平台数据表现。
desc.en: AI social marketing tool for small businesses: import your website, photos, videos or even a meeting recording and it learns the business, builds a content strategy and generates a full month of posts for one-click approval and publishing.

desc.zh: AI 社交媒体管理平台，四步完成文案配图生成、智能排期与多平台发布，支持品牌一致性与数据分析，官方称客户超 63 万，可配合 Claude 等 AI 助手驱动。
desc.en: AI social media management platform: generate copy and visuals, schedule smartly and publish across platforms in four steps, with brand consistency and analytics. 630k+ customers, and it can be driven by assistants such as Claude.

desc.zh: OpusClip 是热门的 AI 长视频切条工具，自动把一段长视频变成多条带字幕、带智能构图的病毒式短视频，方便直接分发到社媒。
desc.en: Popular AI long-video clipper that turns one long video into multiple captioned, intelligently framed short clips ready for social distribution.

desc.zh: 专注短视频工具与爆款玩法研发的 AI 视频平台，官方称上传三十秒视频即可复刻形象与声音定制数字人，输入文案自动生成口播成片，并提供千余公共数字人与公共配音、直播切片。
desc.en: AI video platform focused on short-video tooling and viral formats: upload 30 seconds of video to clone your likeness and voice into a digital human, then turn a script into finished presenter video. Over a thousand public digital humans and voices.

desc.zh: Socialsonic 是 Writesonic 推出的 AI LinkedIn 增长平台，用 AI 帮你找选题、写帖、追热点并持续发布，把个人品牌做成可复制的增长系统。
desc.en: Writesonic's AI LinkedIn growth platform: find topics, write posts, ride trends and keep publishing, turning personal branding into a repeatable growth system.

desc.zh: Submagic 是面向短视频的 AI 字幕与剪辑工具，用自动字幕、表情动效与智能切点让创作者几分钟做出有网感的 Reels、Shorts 与 TikTok 短片。
desc.en: AI captions and editing for short-form video: automatic subtitles, emoji animations and smart cut points let creators produce native-feeling Reels, Shorts and TikToks in minutes.

desc.zh: Taplio 是 LeMPire 出品的 AI LinkedIn 增长工具，帮你找灵感、用你的口吻写帖、按时排期并把受众转化成线索，每天十10分钟即可运营。
desc.en: AI LinkedIn growth tool from LeMPire: find inspiration, write in your voice, schedule on time and convert audience into leads — ten minutes a day is enough.

desc.zh: Tweet Hunter 是面向 X（原 Twitter）的 AI 增长工具，用 AI 帮你找灵感、批量写推文与长帖、自动排期并做互动自动化，积累粉丝与商机。
desc.en: AI growth tool for X (formerly Twitter): find inspiration, batch-write tweets and long posts, schedule automatically and automate engagement to build audience and leads.

desc.zh: Vizard 是 AI 长视频切片工具，把播客、访谈、课程等长内容一键切成 30 多条适合 TikTok、Reels 与 Shorts 的竖屏短片。
desc.en: AI long-video clipper that turns podcasts, interviews and courses into 30+ vertical clips built for TikTok, Reels and Shorts in one click.

desc.zh: 百度智能云 AI 数字人平台，官方称支持人像定制、文心大模型驱动的内容生成与问答、语音合成与音色克隆，提供云渲染与端渲染两种模式，可批量生成电商营销视频与数字人直播。
desc.en: Baidu AI Cloud's digital human platform, supporting custom avatars, ERNIE-driven content generation and Q&A, speech synthesis and voice cloning, with both cloud and on-device rendering for batch e-commerce videos and digital human live streaming.

desc.zh: AI 数字人企业，官方称以有言、有光、有灵三款产品覆盖 3D 数字人视频生成、AI 直播与数字人智能体，提供超写实 3D 形象库、AIGC 声音与三维动画及多端交互能力。
desc.en: AI digital human company whose three products cover 3D digital human video generation, AI live streaming and digital human agents, with a hyper-real 3D avatar library, AIGC voices and 3D animation.

desc.zh: 企业级 AI 交互引擎服务商，官方称构建 AI Voice Agent 语音互动、AI Avatar Agent 数字人直播与 AI UGC Agent 视频创意生成的产品矩阵。
desc.en: Enterprise AI interaction engine provider with a product matrix spanning AI Voice Agent conversation, AI Avatar Agent live streaming and AI UGC Agent video creation.

desc.zh: AI 驱动的营销大数据与数字资产管理平台，官方称提供抖音、快手、小红书等内容电商平台数据与移动广告投放情报，覆盖洞察、决策、策略、素材、投放到归因的全链路。
desc.en: AI-driven marketing big data and digital asset platform, providing data and mobile ad intelligence across Douyin, Kuaishou and Xiaohongshu — from insight, decision and strategy to creative, placement and attribution.

desc.zh: Zebracat 是面向社媒增长的 AI 视频生成器，用文本即可生成带脚本、AI 配音与画面并自动排期的短视频，零剪辑基础也能持续出片。
desc.en: AI video generator for social growth: turn text into short video with script, AI voiceover and visuals, then schedule it automatically — sustainable output with no editing background.

desc.zh: 面向饮食健康管理的应用，官方介绍支持拍照识别餐食营养并给出配餐指导，帮助用户记录每日饮食结构、控制热量摄入，适合关注体重与饮食均衡的人群日常使用。
desc.en: Diet and health management app that recognises meal nutrition from photos and gives guidance, helping users track their daily diet and control calorie intake — for anyone watching weight and balance.

desc.zh: 健康管理平台推出的 AI 饮食与体重管理工具，官方称拥有 160 万以上食物营养数据，用 AI 相机拍餐即可识别重量、热量与营养构成，并自动汇总饮食、运动与睡眠记录。
desc.en: AI diet and weight management tool with 1.6M+ food nutrition records: photograph a meal to identify weight, calories and nutrition, and automatically log diet, exercise and sleep.

desc.zh: 彩云科技推出的 AI 故事创作工具，官方称用户只需设定世界观与人物即可让 AI 续写小说，支持多章节长篇创作、多模型对话切换与故事列表管理，适合网文与同人创作场景。
desc.en: Caiyun's AI story writing tool: set a world and characters and let AI continue the novel, with multi-chapter long-form writing, switching between models and story list management for web fiction and fan works.

desc.zh: 泛心理社区与 AI 陪伴应用，官方称提供心理测评、情绪陪伴与情感解惑服务，用户可在社区交流并在 AI 对话中获得情绪支持，旗下运营企业为北京市高新技术企业。
desc.en: Psychological community and AI companion app offering assessments, emotional companionship and relationship advice, with community discussion and AI conversation for emotional support.

desc.zh: 拍照即搭配的 AI 电子衣橱 App，官方称可自动识别衣物的分类、款式、颜色与材质并完成归类，再根据气温、场合与星座推荐今日穿搭，同时支持配饰组合与拍照搜索灵感。
desc.en: AI wardrobe app that styles outfits from a photo: automatically recognises and categorises clothing by type, style, colour and material, then recommends outfits for the day based on temperature, occasion and star sign, with photo search for inspiration.

desc.zh: 面向服装电商的 AI 图片工具，官方称提供智能抠图、虚拟试衣与高清增强三项能力，可自动分离服装主体生成透明底图、把服装套到模特身上预览效果，并把图片提升至 1K 至 4K。
desc.en: AI image tool for apparel e-commerce with three capabilities — smart cutout, virtual try-on and HD enhancement — separating garments onto transparent backgrounds, previewing them on models, and upscaling images to 1K–4K.

desc.zh: 杭州含光科技推出的 AI 穿搭与智能衣橱应用，官方称支持按上装、下装、鞋履分类整理衣物，提供 AI 试衣预览、可复用搭配推荐，并结合温度、湿度与紫外线给出当日穿搭建议。
desc.en: AI styling and smart wardrobe app that files clothing by tops, bottoms and footwear, offers AI try-on previews and reusable outfit recommendations, and factors in temperature, humidity and UV for daily suggestions.

desc.zh: 运动健身平台的 AI 教练能力，官方称可结合身体数据与训练目标生成个性化运动计划，配合海量跟练课程、跑步骑行记录与智能硬件数据联动，覆盖居家训练与户外运动场景。
desc.en: The AI coaching capability of fitness platform Keep: generate personalised training plans from body data and goals, alongside a large course library, run and cycle tracking, and smart hardware integration for home and outdoor training.

desc.zh: 由下厨房团队推出的菜谱与做饭视频应用，官方介绍以一分钟左右的短视频演示家常菜做法，提供分步图文教程与食材清单，方便厨房新手跟着视频完成一道菜。
desc.en: Recipe and cooking video app from the Xiachufang team, demonstrating home cooking in one-minute videos with step-by-step guides and ingredient lists — easy for kitchen beginners to follow along.

desc.zh: 商汤科技推出的 AI 记账应用，官方称支持拍照与语音快速记账，由 AI 自动识别金额、商户并归类消费类型，覆盖日常收支记录、月度账单分析与消费习惯复盘等场景。
desc.en: SenseTime's AI expense tracking app: log spending by photo or voice and let AI identify amounts and merchants and categorise the expense, with daily records, monthly statements and spending habit review.

desc.zh: 旅游社区与自由行服务平台，官方称已接入大模型推出 AI 旅行攻略助手，可基于海量用户游记与攻略回答目的地问题、生成行程建议，并与社区内容及预订服务相互衔接。
desc.en: Travel community and independent-travel service platform that has added a large-model AI travel assistant, answering destination questions and generating itineraries from its archive of user travelogues and guides, linked to community content and bookings.

desc.zh: 家庭健身器材品牌麦瑞克推出的 AI 健身私教 Mia，官方称基于大模型生成个性化健身方案，并与跑步机、动感单车、椭圆机、划船机及 AR 实景课程联动，为居家健身提供实时指导。
desc.en: AI personal trainer from home fitness equipment brand Merach: large-model-generated personalised plans that work with treadmills, spin bikes, ellipticals, rowers and AR courses for real-time guidance at home.

desc.zh: 阿里旗下的 AI 写真相机，官方称是在线生成专业质感大片的 AI 相机，提供时尚好玩的风格模板，支持高清化、自定义动作与超多写真模板，帮助用户快速产出百变写真照片。
desc.en: Alibaba's AI portrait camera that generates professional-quality photos online, with stylish templates, HD upscaling, custom poses and a large template library for producing varied portraits quickly.

desc.zh: Motion 是用 AI 自动规划你一整天的日历与任务工具，按优先级实时排程并自动重排，帮助个人与团队把待办塞进合适的时间块，减少手动规划。
desc.en: Uses AI to plan your whole day of calendar and tasks, scheduling by priority in real time and rescheduling automatically, so individuals and teams fit to-dos into the right time blocks without manual planning.

desc.zh: 面向养宠人群的宠物社区应用，官方介绍提供 AI 宠物语言翻译与情绪识别，帮助主人理解宠物叫声与行为含义，并可与宠物档案、健康记录与养宠交流等功能配合使用。
desc.en: Pet community app offering AI pet language translation and emotion recognition to help owners understand barks and behaviour, working alongside pet profiles, health records and community discussion.

desc.zh: 专注行程规划的旅行 App，官方称可把小红书、公众号攻略链接一键解析成可执行行程，由 AI 提取地点并生成路线，支持多人协作编辑与旅途中对话式调整。
desc.en: Travel app focused on itinerary planning: parse Xiaohongshu or WeChat article links into an actionable itinerary, with AI extracting places and generating routes, plus collaborative editing and conversational adjustments on the road.

desc.zh: Reclaim.ai 是连接 Google 日历的智能排程工具，自动把任务、习惯、会议与私人事段安排进你的空闲时间，并在冲突时智能调位，后被 Dropbox 收购。
desc.en: Smart scheduling tool that connects to Google Calendar and fits tasks, habits, meetings and personal blocks into your free time, rescheduling intelligently on conflict. Acquired by Dropbox.

desc.zh: 以兴趣消费指南为定位的消费决策平台，官方称聚合全网好价爆料与优惠计算，提供比价标签、今日必买与百亿补贴等栏目，并由值友社区输出评测与晒物内容。
desc.en: Consumer decision platform positioned as an interest-based shopping guide: it aggregates deals and discount calculations from across the web, with price comparison tags, daily picks and subsidy sections, plus reviews from its community.

desc.zh: AI 睡眠监测与助眠应用，官方称无需穿戴设备，用手机传感器与算法分析睡眠阶段、呼吸模式与体动，识别鼾声并筛查睡眠呼吸暂停风险，另提供梦话记录、智能闹钟与助眠音。
desc.en: AI sleep monitoring and aid app that needs no wearable: phone sensors and algorithms analyse sleep stages, breathing patterns and movement, detect snoring and screen for sleep apnoea risk, with sleep-talking recording, a smart alarm and soothing audio.

desc.zh: AI 旅行规划工具，输入日期与目的地即可生成含航班、酒店与活动的完整行程，支持灵活编辑、实时价格与一键预订，已规划 800 万+ 次行程。
desc.en: AI travel planner: enter dates and a destination to get a full itinerary with flights, hotels and activities, flexibly editable with live prices and one-click booking. 8M+ trips planned.

desc.zh: 深圳万德厨科技推出的 AI 烹饪智能体硬件，官方称内置 AI 祝融大模型并学习千余道名厨菜谱，支持蒸煮烤煎炒一机多能、AI 慧眼识材与精准控温，还能同步体检报告生成七日菜谱。
desc.en: AI cooking agent hardware with a built-in Ronghuo large model trained on over a thousand chef recipes: steam, boil, bake, fry and stir in one appliance, with AI ingredient recognition and precise temperature control, and seven-day meal plans generated from a health report.

desc.zh: 全国家居售后服务平台的 AI 智能体，官方称用户用对话方式描述需求即可完成服务派单，覆盖家具安装、维修、测量、配送、清洁与拆旧等品类，平台称服务过程全程可视。
desc.en: AI agent for a national home services platform: describe what you need in conversation and it dispatches a technician, covering furniture assembly, repair, measurement, delivery, cleaning and removal, with the whole process visible.

desc.zh: Whisk 是三星旗下的 AI 美食平台，用图像与文字理解食材与菜谱，帮你把现有食材变成食谱，并规划购物清单与一周餐食，减少外卖与浪费。
desc.en: Samsung's AI food platform that understands ingredients and recipes from images and text, turning what you have into recipes, and planning shopping lists and a week of meals to cut takeout and waste.

desc.zh: Abacus.AI 是面向企业与专业人士的 AI 超级助手平台，集成多家前沿大模型与可编排智能体，内置投研、交易、发票处理、数据分析与内容生成等应用，支持低代码搭建工作流。
desc.en: AI super-assistant platform for enterprises and professionals, integrating frontier models and orchestrated agents with built-in applications for investment research, trading, invoice processing, data analysis and content generation, plus low-code workflow building.

desc.zh: iCourt Alpha 是面向律师与律所的法律 AI 办案平台，提供法律检索、合同审查、文书起草、证据系统与律所管理，并推出 AlphaClaw 数字员工。
desc.en: Legal AI practice platform for lawyers and firms, offering legal research, contract review, document drafting, an evidence system and firm management, plus AlphaClaw digital employees.

desc.zh: 百望股份的票财税合规与商业信用基础设施，提供发票数字化、税务风控、电子会计档案与百望百宝 AI 税务分析师等企业级智能体，服务企业财税数字化转型。
desc.en: Baiwang's invoice, tax and finance compliance and commercial credit infrastructure, with invoice digitisation, tax risk control, electronic accounting archives and the Baiwang Baibao AI tax analyst, serving enterprise finance digitalisation.

desc.zh: Casetext 是法律 AI 研究先驱，旗下 CARA 用 AI 做案例法规检索、文书分析与引用核查，2023 年被 Thomson Reuters 以 6.5 亿美元收购。
desc.en: A legal AI research pioneer whose CARA product handles case law research, document analysis and citation checking. Acquired by Thomson Reuters in 2023 for $650M.

desc.zh: 得理科技基于法律大模型打造智慧法律系统，提供小理 AI、得理法搜、得理律助与开放平台，覆盖法律检索、研究、合同与文书生成。
desc.en: Smart legal system built on a legal large model, offering the Xiaoli AI assistant, legal search, practitioner tools and an open platform for legal research, contract and document generation.

desc.zh: Docsumo 用文档 AI 智能体把邮件与文档工作流端到端自动化，覆盖抽取、分类、核验与回写，官方称字段准确率 99%。
desc.en: Document AI agents that automate email and document workflows end to end across extraction, classification, verification and write-back, with a claimed 99% field accuracy.

desc.zh: 面向消费者的 AI 自助维权平台，用 100+ 工具处理免费试用退订、罚单申诉、隐私保护与退款等事务，成立于 2015 年。
desc.en: Consumer AI self-help platform with 100+ tools for cancelling free trials, disputing fines, protecting privacy and claiming refunds. Founded in 2015.

desc.zh: Evisort 是 AI 合同智能平台（2024 年被 Workday 收购），现以 Workday Contract Intelligence 名义提供。
desc.en: AI contract intelligence platform acquired by Workday in 2024, now offered as Workday Contract Intelligence.

desc.zh: Finchat 是 AI 投研平台（现 Fiscal.ai），把机构级财务数据与对话式 AI 结合，覆盖全球上市公司财报、筛选与文件，数据可溯源。
desc.en: AI investment research platform (now Fiscal.ai) combining institutional-grade financial data with conversational AI, covering global listed-company filings, screening and documents with traceable sources.

desc.zh: Harvey 是面向律师事务所与企业法务的 AI 法律工作平台，由 Harvey 公司打造，提供智能代理、合同分析与文档检索。
desc.en: AI legal work platform for law firms and corporate legal teams, offering intelligent agents, contract analysis and document retrieval.

desc.zh: 合思（原易快报）是费控报销与商旅管理平台，推出合思 AI Partner 智能体矩阵，覆盖单据审核、差旅、付款、收票、档案与经营分析。
desc.en: Expense control, reimbursement and business travel management platform with an AI Partner agent matrix covering document review, travel, payment, invoicing, archiving and business analysis.

desc.zh: 慧算账是面向中小微企业的互联网财税服务平台，提供代理记账、工商注册、税务服务与财税咨询，官方称以 AI 智能财税能力提升企业经营效率。
desc.en: Internet finance and tax service platform for small and micro businesses, offering bookkeeping, company registration, tax services and advisory, with AI tax capabilities to improve operating efficiency.

desc.zh: 国内金融科技公司，业务覆盖证券、基金、银行等机构核心系统，官方称发布 6.0 AI 生态架构并推出金融大模型，加速向 AI 金融科技转型。
desc.en: Chinese fintech company whose core systems serve securities, fund and banking institutions, now rolling out a 6.0 AI ecosystem architecture and a financial large model.

desc.zh: 同花顺旗下的自然语言选股与投研工具，用一句话查询股票、基金、可转债、期货与宏观数据，支持技术面、资金面与基本面多视角选股，并提供热点题材与策略榜单。
desc.en: Natural-language stock screening and research tool from Tonghuashun: query stocks, funds, convertible bonds, futures and macro data in one sentence across technical, capital flow and fundamental angles, with hot themes and strategy rankings.

desc.zh: Kensho 是标普全球旗下的 AI 引擎，把权威金融数据接入大语言模型与智能体工作流，提供确定性检索、自适应检索、文档抽取与实体链接等方案，服务金融机构与企业。
desc.en: S&P Global's AI engine that connects authoritative financial data to large language models and agent workflows, offering deterministic retrieval, adaptive retrieval, document extraction and entity linking for financial institutions.

desc.zh: Lemonade 是用 AI 重构的保险公司，官方称投保约 90 秒、理赔最快 3 秒，提供租房、房屋、车、宠物与寿险，纽交所上市 B Corp。
desc.en: An insurance company rebuilt around AI, claiming signup in about 90 seconds and claims in as little as 3 seconds. Offers renters, home, car, pet and life insurance; NYSE-listed and a B Corp.

desc.zh: 每刻科技提供企业差旅及费用管理 AI 智能平台，覆盖报销、档案、云票、应收与应付，官方称票据识别支持百种样式并可多语言管理全球费用。
desc.en: Enterprise business travel and expense management AI platform covering reimbursement, archiving, e-invoices, receivables and payables, with document recognition across a hundred layouts and multilingual global expense management.

desc.zh: 幂律智能由清华计算机系团队创立，自研法律大模型，提供智能合同审查系统 MeCheck 与合同管理系统 MeFlow，自动提示风险并统一审查标准。
desc.en: Founded by a Tsinghua computer science team with its own legal large model, offering MeCheck for intelligent contract review and MeFlow for contract management, flagging risks automatically and standardising review.

desc.zh: Ramp 是集企业卡、费用管理与应付账款于一体的支出管理平台，用 AI 自动编码发票、审查政策与防欺诈，官方称基础版免费、可 30 天上线。
desc.en: Spend management platform uniting corporate cards, expense management and accounts payable, using AI to code invoices, enforce policy and prevent fraud. Free base tier, live in 30 days.

desc.zh: 通联数据 Datayes 的 AI-Ready 金融数据平台，提供百余个投研数据 API，覆盖研报、行情、财务、基金与宏观，适配 Skill、Agent 与 MCP。
desc.en: AI-ready financial data platform with over a hundred investment research data APIs covering reports, quotes, financials, funds and macro, built for skills, agents and MCP.

desc.zh: 阿里云基于通义千问推出的法律行业大模型，具备法律咨询、案例与法规检索、文书生成、案情分析与合同审查等能力，并提供 API 调用。
desc.en: Alibaba Cloud's legal industry model built on Tongyi Qianwen, handling legal advice, case and statute research, document generation, case analysis and contract review, available through an API.

desc.zh: Vic.ai 是面向企业的 AI 应付账款自动化平台，官方称发票处理提速 5 倍、准确率 99%，可对接 NetSuite、SAP 等主流 ERP。
desc.en: Enterprise AI accounts payable automation platform claiming 5x faster invoice processing at 99% accuracy, integrating with mainstream ERPs including NetSuite and SAP.

desc.zh: 华宇软件旗下法律人工智能公司，产品含元典问达、Yodex 法务平台、元典智库与合规系统，覆盖法律问答、检索、案件与合规管理。
desc.en: Legal AI company under Thunis, with products including Yuandian Wenda, the Yodex legal platform, Yuandian Think Tank and compliance systems for legal Q&A, research, case and compliance management.

desc.zh: 阿里云大模型服务平台，融合 MaaS 与 Agent 能力，提供 AgentStudio 企业级智能体平台，可统一调用通义千问、GLM、Kimi 等主流模型。
desc.en: Alibaba Cloud's large model service platform merging MaaS and agent capabilities, with the enterprise AgentStudio agent platform for calling mainstream models including Tongyi Qianwen, GLM and Kimi.

desc.zh: 百度智能云推出的一站式企业级大模型平台，以 Agent 为核心，覆盖模型开发与应用搭建全流程，内置 MCP 与 Agent 开发工具链。
desc.en: Baidu AI Cloud's one-stop enterprise large model platform, agent-centric and covering the full model development and application building flow, with built-in MCP and an agent development toolchain.

desc.zh: Databricks 是面向企业的数据与 AI 平台，以湖仓架构统一数据工程、分析与 AI 应用，官方称逾六成财富 500 强在用。
desc.en: Enterprise data and AI platform that unifies data engineering, analytics and AI applications on a lakehouse architecture. Used by over 60% of the Fortune 500.

desc.zh: 阿里钉钉面向企业办公推出的 AI 能力入口，把智能助手、文档写作、会议纪要、知识问答与流程自动化嵌入既有协同与审批流程，多端可用，与阿里云、通义等生态协同。
desc.en: Alibaba DingTalk's AI entry point for enterprise work, embedding assistants, document writing, meeting notes, knowledge Q&A and process automation into existing collaboration and approval flows across devices.

desc.zh: 飞书旗下的智能会议工具，语音实时转文字并自动生成结构化会议纪要与待办任务，支持音视频转写，让会议更专注高效，内容可沉淀为团队知识。
desc.en: Feishu's intelligent meeting tool: real-time speech-to-text with structured meeting notes and action items generated automatically, plus audio and video transcription, so content becomes team knowledge.

desc.zh: Front 是面向复杂客户运营的客服与协作平台，把团队、对话与 AI 统一到一个协调系统，官方称 AI 可解决七成请求。
desc.en: Customer service and collaboration platform for complex customer operations, unifying teams, conversations and AI in one coordination system. AI resolves a claimed 70% of requests.

desc.zh: Gong 是面向营收团队的 Revenue AI OS，通过捕获销售通话与会议自动分析客户互动，提供 Gong Engage、Forecast。
desc.en: A Revenue AI OS for revenue teams: it captures sales calls and meetings to analyse customer interactions automatically, with products including Gong Engage and Forecast.

desc.zh: 金蝶是中国企业管理软件与云服务商，以金蝶云与 AI 原生平台助力企业数智化，官方称有 740 多万企业客户，覆盖大中小企业。
desc.en: Enterprise management software and cloud services provider supporting business digitalisation through Kingdee Cloud and an AI-native platform, with 7.4M+ enterprise customers from SMB to large enterprise.

desc.zh: 明略科技是自研大模型能力的企业级 Agentic AI 服务商，产品含 DeepMiner 商业数据分析智能体、章鱼 Octo 协作平台与秒针系统等。
desc.en: Enterprise agentic AI provider with in-house model capability, whose products include the DeepMiner business data analysis agent, the Octo collaboration platform and Miaozhen Systems.

desc.zh: Moveworks 是面向全员的企业 AI 助手平台，用对话跨系统搜索信息并直接执行任务，官方称已服务 350 多家组织、覆盖超 600 万员工。
desc.en: Enterprise AI assistant platform for all employees that searches information across systems and executes tasks through conversation. Serves 350+ organisations covering over 6 million employees.

desc.zh: Salesforce 官方定位为第一的 AI CRM 平台，提供销售云、服务云、营销云、Data Cloud、Tableau、Slack 与智能代理 Agentforce。
desc.en: Positions itself as the number one AI CRM platform, spanning Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Tableau, Slack and the Agentforce agents.

desc.zh: Sana 是 Sana Labs 的企业 AI 平台，把 AI 引入公司应用、知识与文化，用于搜索知识、自动任务并生成文档分析。
desc.en: Sana Labs' enterprise AI platform bringing AI into a company's applications, knowledge and culture to search knowledge, automate tasks and generate document analysis.

desc.zh: 火山引擎的一站式大模型服务平台，提供模型托管与推理、联网插件、RAG 知识库与 Agent 开发能力，并具备多项安全合规认证。
desc.en: Volcengine's one-stop large model service platform, providing model hosting and inference, web plugins, RAG knowledge bases and agent development, with a range of security and compliance certifications.

desc.zh: 火山引擎推出的企业级智能体平台，定位一站式数字员工派遣站，覆盖智能体开发、运行、治理全流程，提供 100+ 插件与场景模板，支持低代码搭建与私有化部署。
desc.en: Volcengine's enterprise agent platform positioned as a one-stop digital employee dispatch station, covering the full agent lifecycle with 100+ plugins and scenario templates, low-code building and private deployment.

desc.zh: 万智提供从研发到部署的全栈 Agent 解决方案，包含 Agent 全生命周期运营平台、Data Agent 数据底座与私有大模型训推一体平台。
desc.en: Offers a full-stack agent solution from development to deployment, including an agent lifecycle operations platform, the Data Agent data foundation and a private large model training and inference platform.

desc.zh: Writer 是面向企业的智能体工作平台，把营销与营收流程连成自主 AI 工作流，让团队直接委派任务而非提示工具，落地企业级治理。
desc.en: Enterprise agent work platform that connects marketing and revenue processes into autonomous AI workflows, so teams delegate tasks instead of prompting tools, with enterprise-grade governance.

desc.zh: 用友是中国企业管理软件与云服务厂商，旗舰平台用友 BIP 融合 AI、数据与流程，并以 YonGPT 企业大模型驱动智能体。
desc.en: Chinese enterprise management software and cloud services vendor whose flagship Yonyou BIP merges AI, data and process, with the YonGPT enterprise model powering agents.

desc.zh: 追一科技提供 AI 数字员工解决方案 AIForce，包含智能服务、外呼、助理、分析、培训与多模态数字人机器人，服务企业与政府智能化转型。
desc.en: Provides the AIForce digital employee suite, including intelligent service, outbound calling, assistant, analytics, training and multimodal digital human bots for enterprise and government digital transformation.

desc.zh: 5118 是营销大数据平台，提供长尾关键词挖掘、SEO 排名监控与 AI 智能改写等站长工具，用于关键词研究与内容创作优化，服务站长与内容运营人员。
desc.en: A marketing data platform for webmasters and content teams, offering long-tail keyword mining, SEO rank monitoring and AI rewriting to support keyword research and content optimization.

desc.zh: ActiveCampaign 是营销自动化与顾客体验自动化平台，整合个性化邮件、WhatsApp、短信与 AI 智能，官方称每周可省约 13 小时。
desc.en: A marketing and customer experience automation platform that combines personalized email, WhatsApp and SMS with AI. The company says it saves teams roughly 13 hours a week.

desc.zh: AdCreative.ai 是专注广告创意生成的 AI 平台，可在数秒产出转化导向的 banner、文案与视频，并用创意评分预测效果，官方称服务超 400 万营销人。
desc.en: An AI platform focused on ad creative generation. It produces conversion-oriented banners, copy and video in seconds and scores creatives to predict performance; the company says it serves over 4 million marketers.

desc.zh: AdRoll 是面向营销者的多渠道广告与 ABM 平台，用机器学习投放展示、社媒与邮件广告，并做跨渠道归因与再营销，提升投放回报。
desc.en: A multi-channel advertising and ABM platform for marketers that uses machine learning to run display, social and email campaigns, with cross-channel attribution and retargeting to improve return on ad spend.

desc.zh: Anyword 的官方口号很直接：「让 AI 内容表现提升 76%」。它的差异点是把 A/B 测试数据与品牌上下文接入生成过程——官方称它可与任何 AI 模型或 Agent 配合，在每一步生成中叠加效果数据…
desc.en: Anyword's pitch is blunt: "make your AI content perform 76% better." Its differentiator is feeding A/B test results and brand context into generation, and the company says it works with any AI model or agent.

desc.zh: 致趣百川是 B2B 一站式营销云，通过营销自动化、内容营销与直播获客打通全渠道数据，形成客户画像并协同销售跟进商机，服务数百家头部 B2B 企业。
desc.en: A one-stop B2B marketing cloud that connects marketing automation, content marketing and live-stream lead generation into unified data, building customer profiles and helping sales work opportunities. It serves hundreds of leading B2B companies.

desc.zh: Brandwatch 是企业级社交倾听与消费者情报套件，官方称用领先 AI 从数十亿条声音中提炼趋势、监控品牌声量并管理跨渠道互动。
desc.en: An enterprise-grade social listening and consumer intelligence suite. The company says its AI distills trends from billions of conversations, monitors brand share of voice and manages cross-channel engagement.

desc.zh: Braze 是面向品牌的客户互动平台，用 BrazeAI 与跨渠道消息、旅程编排统一数据，覆盖从触达到留存的全生命周期，提升用户忠诚度。
desc.en: A customer engagement platform for brands that unifies data with BrazeAI, cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration, covering the full lifecycle from reach to retention to build loyalty.

desc.zh: Clearscope 是面向内容团队的 SEO 与 AI 搜索优化平台，围绕搜索意图与术语建议构建写作流程，并追踪品牌在 AI 回答中的可见度。
desc.en: An SEO and AI search optimization platform for content teams. It structures the writing workflow around search intent and term suggestions, and tracks brand visibility inside AI answers.

desc.zh: Convertlab 提供一体化营销云，包含营销自动化平台 DM Hub、CDP 与隐私增强计算能力，覆盖零售、快消、金融与汽车等行业。
desc.en: An integrated marketing cloud that includes the DM Hub marketing automation platform, CDP and privacy-enhancing computation, serving retail, FMCG, financial and automotive industries.

desc.zh: Copysmith 现在的角色更像一个内容工具集团：它构建并运营三个专门的 AI 平台——Frase（搜索与 AI 引用优化）、Describely（规模化商品内容生产）与 Rytr（用你的语气写作）。
desc.en: Copysmith now behaves more like a content tool group: it builds and runs three dedicated AI platforms, Frase for search and AI citation optimization, Describely for product content at scale, and Rytr for writing in your voice.

desc.zh: 深演智能是企业决策 AI 智能体平台，产品矩阵覆盖产品创新、GTM、社媒营销、广告、导购客服、用户运营与用户洞察等决策场景。
desc.en: An enterprise decision-making AI agent platform whose product matrix spans product innovation, go-to-market, social marketing, advertising, shopping assistants and customer service, user operations and customer insight.

desc.zh: Drift 面向 B2B 销售的对话式 AI 聊天代理，在访客到访时捕捉购买意图并触发销售动作，现过渡为 1mind 并入 Salesloft。
desc.en: A conversational AI chat agent for B2B sales that captures buying intent as visitors arrive and triggers sales actions. It is transitioning into 1mind and joining Salesloft.

desc.zh: HubSpot 是集营销、销售、服务与 CRM 于一体的客户平台，内置 AI 代理，官方称已被全球 299,000 家以上客户使用，适合想把获客到留存打通的团队。
desc.en: A customer platform combining marketing, sales, service and CRM with built-in AI agents. The company says it is used by more than 299,000 customers worldwide, and it suits teams that want to connect acquisition through retention.

desc.zh: 绘蛙是阿里巴巴全资孵化的AI电商图文创作平台，面向卖家与内容创作者，提供AI商拍图、虚拟模特、种草文案与AI视频生成，支持服装一键上身、批量生图与企业团队协作。
desc.en: An AI e-commerce content platform incubated wholly by Alibaba, aimed at sellers and creators. It offers AI product photography, virtual models, social copy and AI video, with one-click clothing try-on, batch image generation and team collaboration.

desc.zh: Intercom 面向客户服务的系统，整合人工帮助台与 Fin AI 代理，用全渠道收件箱、工单与 AI 辅助覆盖售前到售后支持。
desc.en: A customer service system that combines a human help desk with the Fin AI agent, covering pre-sale to post-sale support through a shared inbox, tickets and AI assistance.

desc.zh: 面向营销团队的 AI Agent 工作台，内置 100+ 专用智能体与内容流水线，覆盖从策略到落地的端到端营销流程，兼顾速度与品牌一致性。
desc.en: An AI agent workspace for marketing teams with more than 100 purpose-built agents and content pipelines, covering end-to-end marketing from strategy to execution while balancing speed and brand consistency.

desc.zh: 径硕科技主打 Agentic Marketing，为 B2B 企业提供 Agentic CDP 数据底座与 GEO、内容、SDR、邮件、销售、服务等六大智能体。
desc.en: Jingshuo Technology focuses on agentic marketing, giving B2B companies an agentic CDP data foundation plus six agents spanning GEO, content, SDR, email, sales and service.

desc.zh: Klaviyo 是面向 B2C 的自主式 CRM 与 AI 营销平台，打通邮件、短信、WhatsApp 等渠道并用 AI 代理驱动个性化营销与服务。
desc.en: An autonomous CRM and AI marketing platform for B2C that connects email, SMS and WhatsApp, using AI agents to drive personalized marketing and service.

desc.zh: 面向销售的 AI 邮件教练，实时分析外联邮件给出改进建议，另有 Ora AI 销售 Agent 自动起草接近顶尖销售水平的邮件，并提供认证课程，适合 B2B 外联团队。
desc.en: An AI email coach for sales that analyzes outreach in real time and suggests improvements. Its Ora AI sales agent drafts emails at the level of top performers, and it offers certification courses, making it a fit for B2B outreach teams.

desc.zh: Manychat 面向创作者与小企业的聊天营销平台，在 Instagram、WhatsApp、TikTok 与 Messenger 上用自动化把评论转成交。
desc.en: A chat marketing platform for creators and small businesses that uses automation on Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok and Messenger to turn comments into conversions.

desc.zh: MarketMuse 是 AI 驱动的内容规划与优化软件，用专利主题建模分析内容库存，指出该写什么、写多少以建立主题权威。
desc.en: AI-driven content planning and optimization software that uses patented topic modeling to audit your content inventory and show what to write and how much, to build topical authority.

desc.zh: 秒针系统是明略科技旗下营销智能品牌，提供广告测量、社媒营销与用户营销服务，官方称以事实性数据反 AI 幻觉做营销实效管理，服务品牌广告效果衡量场景。
desc.en: A marketing intelligence brand under MiningLamp Technology offering ad measurement, social marketing and user marketing. The company says it uses factual data to counteract AI hallucination for marketing effectiveness, serving brand ad measurement.

desc.zh: OKKI AI 是阿里巴巴国际站旗下小满科技推出的AI外贸智能体，覆盖潜客挖掘、AI背调、多语言开发信、智能触达与客户经营，官方称已服务25万以上外贸从业者。
desc.en: An AI foreign-trade agent from Xiaoman Technology under Alibaba.com, covering prospect mining, AI background checks, multilingual outreach letters, smart touchpoints and customer management. The company says it serves over 250,000 trade professionals.

desc.zh: Persado 是面向受监管行业的内容生成平台，用语言智能与多智能体编排产出合规营销文案，并对每条信息的表现与合规打分，降低人工校对成本。
desc.en: A content generation platform for regulated industries that uses language intelligence and multi-agent orchestration to produce compliant marketing copy and score each message for performance and compliance, cutting manual review costs.

desc.zh: Pic Copilot 是阿里巴巴国际数字商业集团推出的AI电商内容平台，面向跨境卖家，提供AI模特图、虚拟试穿、营销视频、图片翻译与背景生成，官方称已服务全球超150万卖家。
desc.en: An AI e-commerce content platform from Alibaba's international digital commerce group, aimed at cross-border sellers. It offers AI model images, virtual try-on, marketing video, image translation and background generation; the company says it serves over 1.5 million sellers worldwide.

desc.zh: Postwise 的官方 slogan 是「几秒内把想法变成爆款帖子」。它主要面向 Twitter/X、LinkedIn 与 Threads 三个平台：输入一个想法，AI 生成多条候选帖子，再批量排期发布。
desc.en: Postwise's slogan is "turn ideas into viral posts in seconds." It targets Twitter/X, LinkedIn and Threads: enter an idea, get several candidate posts from AI, then schedule them in batches.

desc.zh: Predis.ai 面向成长型团队的 AI 广告生成器，从文字、商品链接或图片生成视频、UGC 与图片广告，并给创意打分。
desc.en: An AI ad generator for growth teams that turns text, product links or images into video, UGC and image ads, and scores the creatives.

desc.zh: 兔展智能自研视觉空间智能大模型矩阵，推出 RabbitVis 设计工具、RabbitMarketing OS 营销智能体与 SkillsUI 智能交互底座。
desc.en: Rabbitpre developed its own matrix of visual-spatial intelligence models and launched the RabbitVis design tool, the RabbitMarketing OS marketing agent and the SkillsUI interaction foundation.

desc.zh: Smartly.io 面向品牌与代理公司的 AI 广告平台，覆盖创意生产、跨渠道投放与效果洞察，把媒体与创意整合到统一工作流。
desc.en: An AI advertising platform for brands and agencies covering creative production, cross-channel delivery and performance insight, bringing media and creative into one workflow.

desc.zh: Surfer SEO 是内容优化与 SEO 平台，整合关键词研究、内容编辑与排名追踪，并覆盖 Google 与 ChatGPT 等 AI 引擎可见度。
desc.en: A content optimization and SEO platform that unites keyword research, content editing and rank tracking, and also covers visibility in AI engines such as Google and ChatGPT.

desc.zh: Sybill 是面向营收团队的 AI 销售助手，先沉淀顶尖销售的成交打法，再帮全队执行会谈准备、跟进邮件与 CRM 更新，减少本可赢下的丢单。
desc.en: An AI sales assistant for revenue teams that first captures how top sellers close, then helps the whole team with meeting prep, follow-up email and CRM updates, reducing winnable deals lost.

desc.zh: 微播易是一站式社媒投放平台，依托社交大数据与 AI 技术提供投前舆情分析、投中跨平台 KOL 采购与原生内容营销、投后分析与优化。
desc.en: A one-stop social media placement platform that uses social big data and AI to provide pre-campaign sentiment analysis, mid-campaign cross-platform KOL sourcing with native content marketing, and post-campaign analysis and optimization.

desc.zh: 微盟的 AI 原生产品矩阵，包含星启 GEO、星拓 AI 拓客、星枢全域运营、星元私域管家与星创创意引擎，覆盖获客到提效经营场景。
desc.en: Weimob's AI-native product matrix, including Xingqi GEO, Xintuo AI prospecting, Xinshu omnichannel operations, Xingyuan private-domain management and Xingchuang creative engine, covering acquisition through operational efficiency.

desc.zh: 易撰面向内容创作者与新媒体运营团队，从多平台公开内容中发现创作灵感、追踪对标账号，并用 AI 把参考素材打磨成自己的表达，面向自媒体与内容运营团队。
desc.en: Yizhuan helps content creators and new-media teams find inspiration in public content across platforms, track benchmark accounts, and use AI to reshape reference material into their own voice.

desc.zh: 有赞提供智能化客户运营与社交电商工具，推出 AI 数字员工与 AGI 获客能力，让商品在浏览、搜索与 AI 对话中被推荐给消费者，面向零售商家私域经营场景。
desc.en: Youzan provides intelligent customer operations and social commerce tools, launching AI digital employees and AGI acquisition capabilities so products get recommended during browsing, search and AI conversations. It targets retail private-domain operations.

desc.zh: Abridge 是面向医生的生成式 AI 临床文档工具，在医患对话中实时生成结构化病历、编码与小结，由临床医生为临床医生打造，笔记需医生审阅。
